documents.title: Carpentry Repairs, Replacements & Improvements in Sydney — The questions behind a repair enquiry
documents.text:
The questions behind a repair enquiry
No single photo can settle every repair. These are the decisions worth making clear before work begins.

documents.title: Carpentry Repairs, Replacements & Improvements in Sydney — What will the quote include?
documents.text:
What will the quote include?
Ask for the timber work, materials, access, finishing and any removal to be identified separately. A photograph helps start the conversation, but concealed damage or site access can change the scope.

documents.title: Carpentry Repairs, Replacements & Improvements in Sydney — Can we repair only the damaged part?
documents.text:
Can we repair only the damaged part?
Sometimes. The adjoining timber, fixings and cause of moisture or movement need checking first. A local repair should not hide an unstable support or an unresolved leak.

documents.title: Carpentry Repairs, Replacements & Improvements in Sydney — What if hidden damage appears?
documents.text:
What if hidden damage appears?
Stop and explain the newly visible condition before extra work. Agree the changed method, materials and cost in writing rather than treating an initial photo estimate as an unlimited approval.

documents.title: Carpentry Repairs, Replacements & Improvements in Sydney — How will the work affect the home?
documents.text:
How will the work affect the home?
Ask which areas need access, whether a door or window will be temporarily out of use, and what preparation, making good and waste removal are included. The answer depends on the agreed job.

documents.title: 悉尼住宅木工维修、更换与改造 — 这些损坏可能需要怎样维修？
documents.text:
这些损坏可能需要怎样维修？
以下是判断起点，不是凭照片作诊断。选择最接近的情况，看看应先确认什么。

documents.title: 悉尼住宅木工维修、更换与改造 — 门窗关不顺
documents.text:
门窗关不顺
先看门窗框、铰链及受潮迹象，不要直接假定要整套更换。

documents.title: 悉尼住宅木工维修、更换与改造 — 户外木构件松动或发软
documents.text:
户外木构件松动或发软
围栏、木闸门或 Deck 应先看固定件和支撑木材，再讨论外观收尾。

documents.title: 悉尼住宅木工维修、更换与改造 — 不确定该修还是换
documents.text:
不确定该修还是换
拍下整个构件及损坏局部；周围木材是否稳固，才影响局部维修是否合适。

documents.title: 悉尼住宅木工维修、更换与改造 — 客户真正担心的，不只是木头坏了
documents.text:
客户真正担心的，不只是木头坏了
一张照片不能决定所有维修；开始前，值得把这些判断说明白。

documents.title: 悉尼住宅木工维修、更换与改造 — 报价包含哪些工作？
documents.text:
报价包含哪些工作？
请分别确认木作、材料、通道、表面收尾及拆旧清运。照片可帮助初步沟通，但隐蔽损坏与现场通道可能改变工作范围。

documents.title: 悉尼住宅木工维修、更换与改造 — 能只修坏掉的部分吗？
documents.text:
能只修坏掉的部分吗？
有时可以，但先要看相邻木材、固定处，以及受潮或移动的原因。局部维修不应掩盖不稳的支撑或仍在漏水的位置。

documents.title: 悉尼住宅木工维修、更换与改造 — 拆开后发现更多损坏怎么办？
documents.text:
拆开后发现更多损坏怎么办？
增加工作前应先暂停，说明新发现的情况，再以书面确认变更后的方法、材料与费用；初步照片估算不等于无限追加工作的同意。

documents.title: 悉尼住宅木工维修、更换与改造 — 施工会怎样影响家里？
documents.text:
施工会怎样影响家里？
可先确认需要进入哪些位置、门窗会否暂时不能使用，以及前期准备、收尾和清运包含什么；具体安排取决于同意的工作范围。

documents.title: Carpentry enquiries for Appin — A useful enquiry example
documents.text:
A useful enquiry example
Planning timber sleeper edging? Include the border length, corners and the ground level on each side, not only the number of sleepers.

documents.title: Carpentry enquiries for Appin — A useful enquiry example
documents.text:
A useful enquiry example
For new edging, agree the line, corners, finished height and access before materials are ordered. For replacement, check the adjoining timber and fixing points as well as the damaged sleeper. Where soil is being retained, the load, support and drainage need their own assessment before a method or price is agreed.

documents.title: Carpentry enquiries for Appin — A useful enquiry example
documents.text:
A useful enquiry example
Planning the repair

documents.title: Carpentry enquiries for Appin — Will the timber separate a garden bed or retain a change in level?
documents.text:
Will the timber separate a garden bed or retain a change in level?
A low garden border and timber holding back soil need different assessment. Show how the proposed line meets paths and existing fences, and where water runs. Include the route for long timber and old material removal. Agree the support, ground preparation and any drainage work before buying sleepers. A simple garden-edge quotation should not be treated as a complete retaining-wall scope.

documents.title: Carpentry enquiries for Appin — Photos that help define this work
documents.text:
Photos that help define this work
Show the whole proposed line, existing sleepers and any slope, nearby paving, fence or drain. Include a rough measurement without digging or moving unstable timber.

documents.title: Carpentry enquiries for Appin — What changes the quote
documents.text:
What changes the quote
Send the approximate total length, visible height, number of corners and photos from both sides. Material choice, ground preparation, supports, access, removal of old sleepers and finishing should be itemised. An edging-only quote should not be compared with a retaining-wall quote as if they include the same work.

documents.title: Carpentry enquiries for Appin — Agree the inclusions
documents.text:
Agree the inclusions
This service covers timber sleeper enquiries for garden edging and small outdoor timber projects. A retaining wall is a different scope from a simple garden border; structural design, drainage and any required approvals must be checked separately. Concrete sleepers, excavation near utilities and alterations to pool barriers are not automatically included.

documents.title: Carpentry enquiries for Appin — Compare repair options for this job
documents.text:
Compare repair options for this job
Compare replacing the failed lengths with resetting a continuous edge. List retained timber, new supports, ground preparation and disposal separately; painting is not a remedy for unstable timber.

documents.title: Carpentry enquiries for Appin — Preparing access and the quote
documents.text:
Preparing access and the quote
Include Appin in your enquiry, a wide photo, a close-up of each fault and approximate dimensions. Mention any shared access, stairs, parking or property-manager arrangements that apply to your property. You do not need to publish a full street address.

documents.title: Carpentry enquiries for Appin — Preparing access and the quote
documents.text:
Preparing access and the quote
Mark which timber you want to keep and which parts may need replacement. Ask the quote to separate timber, hardware, finishing and removal of old materials so you can compare the same scope of work.

documents.title: Carpentry enquiries for Appin — Can I ask about fence maintenance here?
documents.text:
Can I ask about fence maintenance here?
Yes. Describe posts, rails, boards and fixings, then use the timber fence maintenance page to prepare photos. Confirm the work at your location before booking.

documents.text:

documents.title: Appin 木工维修与保养 — 询价准备示例
documents.text:
询价准备示例
计划安装木 sleeper 边框？请说明总长度、转角和两侧地面高低，而不只报 sleeper 数量。

documents.title: Appin 木工维修与保养 — 询价准备示例
documents.text:
询价准备示例
新装前先确认边界走向、转角、完成高度及材料进出通道。更换时除了受损 sleeper，还要看相邻木材和固定点是否稳固。涉及挡土功能时，应单独评估受力、支撑与排水，再确定方法及报价。

documents.title: Appin 木工维修与保养 — 木材用于分隔花坛，还是挡住地面高低差？
documents.text:
木材用于分隔花坛，还是挡住地面高低差？
低矮花园边框与需要挡土的木材，评估重点不同。请拍出计划走向与步道、围栏的连接以及水流位置，并说明长木材进出和旧料清运通道。采购 sleeper 前，先确认支撑、地面准备及可能需要的排水工作，避免把简单边框报价当作完整挡土工程。

documents.title: Appin 木工维修与保养 — 有助于判断这类工作的照片
documents.text:
有助于判断这类工作的照片
拍下整段计划走向、现有 sleeper、坡度及附近步道、围栏或排水位置。可提供粗略尺寸，不要为拍照开挖或移动不稳的木材。

documents.title: Appin 木工维修与保养 — 哪些项目影响报价
documents.text:
哪些项目影响报价
提供大致总长度、露出高度、转角数量及两侧照片。材料、地面准备、支撑、搬运通道、拆旧清运与表面收尾应分别说明，避免把仅做花园边框的报价与完整挡土工程直接比较。

documents.title: Appin 木工维修与保养 — 先确认包含哪些工作
documents.text:
先确认包含哪些工作
本服务承接花园木边框及小型户外木作的 timber sleeper 询价。挡土墙与简单花园边界不是同一范围；结构设计、排水和可能需要的审批须另行核对。混凝土 sleeper、地下管线附近开挖及泳池安全围栏改动不默认包含。

documents.title: Appin 木工维修与保养 — 这项工作怎样比较方案
documents.text:
这项工作怎样比较方案
比较只换坏木料与重新整理连续边框，分别列出保留木材、新支撑、地面准备及清运。刷漆不能代替解决木材不稳的问题。

documents.title: Appin 木工维修与保养 — 整理通道与报价资料
documents.text:
整理通道与报价资料
询价请注明 Appin，提供全景、每类损坏的近照及大致尺寸。如涉及共用通道、楼梯、停车或物业管理安排，请一并说明；不需要公开完整街道地址。

documents.title: Appin 木工维修与保养 — 整理通道与报价资料
documents.text:
整理通道与报价资料
标出希望保留及可能需要更换的木材。让报价分开写木材、五金、表面收尾和旧料清运，方便按相同工作范围比较方案。

documents.title: Appin 木工维修与保养 — 这里可以咨询围栏保养吗？
documents.text:
这里可以咨询围栏保养吗？
可以。说明立柱、横梁、木板及固定件情况，并按木围栏保养页准备照片；预约前确认当地工作范围。

How can several uneven cupboard doors be quoted together?
Label each door on a closed overview, then photograph one fixing set per different hinge type. Distinguish loose fittings from damaged cabinet panels. The quote should state whether it covers alignment across the whole run or selected doors only, along with the number of hinges and any board repairs. Several uneven doors do not automatically mean the full set needs replacement.

documents.text:
How can a long fence be broken into comparable quote sections?
Break a longer timber fence into numbered spans rather than asking for one undifferentiated replacement price. On a simple sketch, count affected posts, rails and palings within each span, and mark the sections that remain sound. Include gate junctions, changes in ground level and access for long materials or removal. Maintenance of isolated loose boards, replacement of selected rails and a new fence run require different quantities and fixing plans. Ask for each option to show retained timber, replacement components, disposal and any surface preparation or coating. If posts move or support is uncertain, the scope must address that before an appearance-only finish is chosen. For a shared fence, confirm the agreed boundary and entry arrangements with the relevant people before booking. You can then compare a staged repair with a larger replacement on the same stated scope, without losing sound sections in a whole-fence allowance.

Is the timber surround the same repair as a sliding-window mechanism?
Show the moving sash and the stationary timber surround separately, with the point that sticks marked. Explain whether the concern is frame damage, the track or a latch. Ask which timber work can be scoped and which mechanism or glazing tasks need separate expertise. Do not assume a surround repair includes replacing the window unit. A window that will not slide does not establish that every fault is in the timber surround.

When can a damaged sill end be repaired locally?
Show the full sill, its end joint and the adjacent upright. State whether damage is isolated or continues into the frame. A local repair needs a sound connection and a suitable water-shedding detail; ask for the proposed repair boundary, any replacement length and coating scope rather than a filler-only description. Confirm unknown internal conditions after inspection.

documents.title: Carpentry enquiries for Fairfield — A useful enquiry example

A local section may be repaired or replaced if the profile can be matched and the substrate is sound. For a loose or replacement shelf, the bracket or cabinet support, span, expected load and fixing surface need checking before a method is chosen. Several small items can be scoped together, but material supply, access to occupied rooms and any wet-wall source should be discussed before scheduling.

documents.title: Carpentry enquiries for Fairfield — What changes the scope of a skirting corner repair?
documents.text:
What changes the scope of a skirting corner repair?
Photograph both sides of the corner and show whether the damage reaches behind either run. Note any gap at the floor and whether the original profile continues elsewhere in the room. Ask how the corner joint, matching length and paint transition will be treated; a small visible chip may not define the complete repair boundary. Confirm the connections before choosing a local patch or replacement to a suitable joint.

documents.title: Carpentry enquiries for Fairfield — Photos that help define this work

documents.title: Carpentry enquiries for Fairfield — What changes the quote
documents.text:
What changes the quote
Show the full trim length, an end/profile view, damaged section and adjacent wall. For shelves, show existing supports, approximate width/depth and the surface they fix to. Quantity, lengths, profile availability, material supply, fixing access, patching and painting affect the estimate.

documents.title: Carpentry enquiries for Fairfield — Agree the inclusions
documents.text:
Agree the inclusions
This is not a promise of whole-house bespoke joinery, structural alteration, floor sanding or antique furniture restoration. Shelf installation is subject to the actual fixing and load scope being approved; cabinet hinges and drawers have a separate service. Wall patching and painting are not automatically included.

documents.title: Carpentry enquiries for Gordon — How are gutter work and timber fascia repairs separated?
documents.text:
How are gutter work and timber fascia repairs separated?
Photograph the roof edge from the ground so the gutter, fascia and any eaves lining can be identified separately. Show the visible damaged timber and describe observed drips or staining without climbing up to diagnose the leak. A fascia repair needs a plan for whatever is attached to the board: gutter brackets, joints and adjacent timber may affect removal and reinstatement. Confirm which contractor handles the leak source and any gutter work before the carpentry is booked. Compare a local timber replacement with a longer replacement to sound fixing points, rather than assuming the stained patch is the entire damaged area. The written scope should identify access equipment, temporary removal, replacement timber, reinstatement and preparation or coating. Ask what happens if concealed deterioration is found after opening the section. Agree additional work and cost before extending the repair.

If the leaf is sound, rehanging or suitable hardware may solve the problem. A decayed post or rail needs timber work, and a distorted leaf may warrant replacement. The fixing substrate and access matter as much as the visible latch.

documents.title: Carpentry enquiries for Gymea — What should be checked before replacing worn gate hardware?
documents.text:
What should be checked before replacing worn gate hardware?
Photograph the hinge and latch fixings as well as the timber beneath them. State whether the gate still sits square when closed. Hardware replacement needs compatible dimensions and reliable fixing material. Ask whether repairing timber, rehanging and testing the closing action are included, rather than assuming a new fitting resolves a damaged support.

Show the gate open and closed, the scrape point, both posts and readable hardware. Dimensions, post condition, hinge fixing and hardware availability influence the repair.

This covers manually operated timber gates. Motors, remotes, automatic systems and pool safety certification are separate specialist matters. Hardware replacement and a whole new gate must be explicitly within an approved quote.

documents.title: Carpentry enquiries for Hornsby — A useful enquiry example

A single post or rail can sometimes be replaced while keeping sound panels. Repeated failing posts or widespread decay may make a longer section more practical. Discuss boundaries and neighbour access with the relevant owners before work is arranged.

documents.title: Carpentry enquiries for Hornsby — Can a soft fence post be replaced while keeping the rails?
documents.text:
Can a soft fence post be replaced while keeping the rails?
Show the post base and where each rail enters or fixes to the post. Note which adjacent spans must remain in place and any access obstacles. Retention depends on the condition of the joints and timber, so request an allowance for affected connections rather than assuming all rails can be reused unchanged. Distinguish removal of the old post, installation of the new post and waste removal.

This is timber fencing, not Colorbond, glass pool fencing or powered gates. Boundary ownership and cost sharing are matters for the parties and applicable advice, not a legal conclusion from a website. New full-fence installation requires separate scope approval.

documents.title: Carpentry enquiries for Kellyville — Why does a wide timber gate need more than a hinge quote?
documents.text:
Why does a wide timber gate need more than a hinge quote?
For a wide timber gate, provide an overview showing the whole leaf, rail or brace joints, both hinges and the supporting posts. Include closed gaps and the direction of opening. A latch adjustment cannot correct a post that moves, and trimming the bottom may conceal a dropping leaf. The gate width, timber condition and available clearance help define whether the leaf can be repaired and rehung or whether post and support work is also needed. Explain whether the opening serves pedestrians, vehicles or regular material access, and whether another entry can be used during the work. Compare leaf repair, compatible hardware and post work as separate items, including the final latch and ground-clearance check. If the gate is part of a pool barrier, identify that use at the start so the correct scope can be established before ordinary garden-gate work is proposed.

A new cabinet hinge needs a sound fixing surface. Photograph the hinge cup, mounting plate, damaged screw holes and the panel edge where visible, and keep detached fittings for identification. documents.text:
Can window painting and opening repairs be quoted together?
For timber window work, list the result you want: easier opening, replacement of damaged wood, a refreshed coating, or a combination. Show the complete closed window, peeling areas and the point where movement stops. Painting can improve the surface but does not restore decayed timber or repair a balance mechanism. Ask to separate timber and joint repairs from catches, balances and glazing so each trade and inclusion is clear. A window with sound wood may need preparation and coating; softness, splitting or a failed sill joint calls for a repair assessment first. Confirm which faces and edges will be finished and whether access to the outside is needed. Mention rooms that need to stay usable and ask how opening, drying and temporary security will be arranged. Comparing these agreed outcomes is more useful than comparing a repaint price with a complete timber repair.

documents.text:
When does a dragging gate need post work instead of trimming?
A dragging timber gate can result from the leaf sagging, hinge fixings loosening or the supporting post moving. Photograph the hinge-side and latch-side gaps with the gate open and closed, including the post base and adjoining fence. Do not push an unstable post to test it. Ask which component causes the change in clearance before selecting a repair. A sound leaf and stable post may allow adjustment or rehanging; damaged joints or moving support need a wider scope. Compare those options with trimming only after the alignment has been checked. Explain the ground surface across the swing and whether access must remain available during work. The agreed scope should identify timber retained and replaced, compatible hardware, the closing and latch check, and any finishing. If the gate protects pool access, tell us before booking so the work is assessed for that use.

Need timber repairs in Neutral Bay? Start with the affected part, see which service fits and tell us what is happening at your property.

documents.title: Carpentry enquiries for Neutral Bay — A useful enquiry example

For loose internal shelves, describe the intended load and show the brackets and fixing surface; stronger boards alone may not solve the issue.

documents.title: Carpentry enquiries for Neutral Bay — A useful enquiry example
documents.text:
A useful enquiry example
A local section may be repaired or replaced if the profile can be matched and the substrate is sound. For a loose or replacement shelf, the bracket or cabinet support, span, expected load and fixing surface need checking before a method is chosen. Several small items can be scoped together, but material supply, access to occupied rooms and any wet-wall source should be discussed before scheduling.

documents.title: Carpentry enquiries for Neutral Bay — What information helps scope a loose shelf repair?
documents.text:
What information helps scope a loose shelf repair?
Describe what the shelf is intended to hold and photograph the full unsupported span, brackets and fixing surface. A loose bracket, a bending shelf and a damaged cabinet side call for different solutions; increasing board thickness alone may leave the original fixing problem unresolved. Do not add weight to demonstrate movement. From accessible views, note whether the shelf fixes into a wall, cabinet or freestanding unit and whether the existing holes remain sound. Compare retaining suitable supports with altering the support layout, including any drilling, board replacement and making good. If the wall material or hidden services are unknown, say so rather than assuming a fixing method. Ask the quote to define the intended use and finishing requirements, including exposed edges. Where several shelves need attention, label them separately so the quantity and different spans are not lost in one general shelving allowance.

documents.title: Carpentry enquiries for Neutral Bay — Photos that help define this work
documents.text:
Photos that help define this work
Include a full run and profile detail with an approximate length; do not pull off a sound trim for a photo.

documents.title: Carpentry enquiries for Neutral Bay — What changes the quote
documents.text:
What changes the quote
Show the full trim length, an end/profile view, damaged section and adjacent wall. For shelves, show existing supports, approximate width/depth and the surface they fix to. Quantity, lengths, profile availability, material supply, fixing access, patching and painting affect the estimate.

documents.title: Carpentry enquiries for Neutral Bay — Agree the inclusions
documents.text:
Agree the inclusions
This is not a promise of whole-house bespoke joinery, structural alteration, floor sanding or antique furniture restoration. Shelf installation is subject to the actual fixing and load scope being approved; cabinet hinges and drawers have a separate service. Wall patching and painting are not automatically included.

documents.title: Carpentry enquiries for Neutral Bay — Compare repair options for this job
documents.text:

Ask for the proposed shelf support layout, fixings and usable load description together. A thicker board is one option only if the fixing surface can carry the intended use.

documents.title: Carpentry enquiries for Redfern — What determines whether a short skirting section can be matched?
documents.text:
What determines whether a short skirting section can be matched?
Start with the skirting profile, not a paint colour. Measure the visible height and the length between corners, and photograph an undamaged length beside the damaged section. An exposed end can help identify the shape without removing sound trim. A short replacement is practical only if its thickness, profile and joint position fit the retained timber. If a close match is unavailable, compare replacing to the next corner with keeping an obvious splice; agree that finish before removal. Check whether damage stops at the trim or continues into the wall behind it. The quote should distinguish timber supply and fitting from wall repairs, nail-hole filling, caulking and painting. Mention finished flooring and furniture beside the wall so protection and access can be planned. Ask to see the proposed joint locations before work starts.

documents.text:
Which measurements matter for replacement drawer runners?
A replacement drawer runner must fit the drawer box, cabinet opening and mounting system together. From safe access, photograph the runner markings, its fixing positions and the drawer both open and closed. Record the runner length and opening width if visible; do not dismantle a loaded drawer just to measure it. Explain whether it binds throughout its travel, drops on one side or will not close the last few centimetres. Those problems can involve adjustment, worn runners or loose cabinet-side fixings. Ask whether both runners need replacing as a compatible pair and whether the retained drawer and cabinet can hold the new fixings. Compare the complete fitted repair, including alignment and checking the final travel, with the price of parts alone. If suitable parts are unavailable, agree any changes to the drawer or mounting layout before purchase.

documents.title: Carpentry enquiries for Surry Hills — Should a freshly painted rubbing door be planed immediately?
documents.text:
Should a freshly painted rubbing door be planed immediately?
If a timber door started rubbing after painting, record when the fault appeared and where the door touches. Show the hinge side, top gap and contact edge in both open and closed views. Coating build-up may need a small surface correction, while a dropped leaf or moving frame needs alignment or fixing work. Planing immediately can leave an excessive gap if the underlying movement is later corrected. Ask for the cause and retained clearance to be established before timber is removed. Where trimming is appropriate, agree cut-edge sealing and the extent of repainting; painting the whole leaf is a different allowance from finishing one edge. Identify any fire-door or other rating label before work is scoped. Also explain if the entrance must remain secure and usable, so adjustment, repair and any temporary closure can be arranged around the actual use of the door.

刚刷漆的门刮擦，是否马上刨门？
木门刷漆后开始刮擦，请记录出现时间和接触位置，拍开启、关闭状态的铰链侧、顶缝及摩擦边。积漆可能只需表面处理；门扇下垂或门框移动则需对位和固定维修。先刨门，之后再纠正移动，可能留下过大缝隙。切木前先确认原因与需要保留的间隙。适合修边时，写清切口封闭及补漆范围，整扇重刷与只处理一条边是不同项目。门上有防火或其他性能标识时，界定工作前先说明。也请告知入口是否必须继续锁闭和使用，便于按实际用途安排调整、维修及临时关闭。

documents.title: Carpentry enquiries for Westmead — What identifies the right replacement for a jamming kitchen drawer?
documents.text:
What identifies the right replacement for a jamming kitchen drawer?
Photograph manufacturer markings, the runner position and the cabinet opening. Say whether the drawer jams empty as well as loaded, without dismantling an unsafe fitting. Soft-close features, length and fixing pattern may differ. Ask for part identification before purchase and for adjustment and cabinet-side repairs to be included where needed. Similar appearance does not establish part compatibility.

For skirting or architraves after another repair, photograph the unfinished junctions and the profile of the timber you want matched.

documents.title: Carpentry enquiries for Zetland — A useful enquiry example
documents.text:
A useful enquiry example
A local section may be repaired or replaced if the profile can be matched and the substrate is sound. For a loose or replacement shelf, the bracket or cabinet support, span, expected load and fixing surface need checking before a method is chosen. Several small items can be scoped together, but material supply, access to occupied rooms and any wet-wall source should be discussed before scheduling.

documents.title: Carpentry enquiries for Zetland — Should a small trim gap be patched or a continuous length replaced?
documents.text:
Should a small trim gap be patched or a continuous length replaced?
Measure between corners and show an undamaged section alongside the gap. Matching depends on the profile, thickness and available material. Explain whether adjoining walls and flooring are already finished so protection and touch-ups are included. Agree where a new length will stop before removal begins. Define where the new length begins as well as where it ends, so a small patch does not become an unclear allowance for finishing the whole wall.

documents.title: Carpentry enquiries for Zetland — Photos that help define this work
documents.text:
Photos that help define this work
Include a full run and profile detail with an approximate length; do not pull off a sound trim for a photo.

documents.text:
What changes the quote
Show the full trim length, an end/profile view, damaged section and adjacent wall. For shelves, show existing supports, approximate width/depth and the surface they fix to. Quantity, lengths, profile availability, material supply, fixing access, patching and painting affect the estimate.

documents.title: Carpentry enquiries for Zetland — Agree the inclusions
documents.text:
Agree the inclusions
This is not a promise of whole-house bespoke joinery, structural alteration, floor sanding or antique furniture restoration. Shelf installation is subject to the actual fixing and load scope being approved; cabinet hinges and drawers have a separate service. Wall patching and painting are not automatically included.

documents.title: Carpentry enquiries for Zetland — Compare repair options for this job
documents.text:

documents.title: Zetland 木工维修与保养 — 装饰线小缺口适合补一段，还是换连续整段？

装饰线小缺口适合补一段，还是换连续整段？
量转角之间长度，并把完好线条和缺口一起拍下。能否匹配取决于线型、厚度及可采购材料；请说明相邻墙面与地板是否已完成，便于列出保护和补色。拆除前先确定新木条从哪里开始、在哪里结束，避免小补段最后变成范围不清的整面收尾。

documents.title: Carpentry questions
documents.text:
Carpentry questions
These are starting points. A photo and location can change the repair method and quote.

documents.title: Carpentry questions — Do you need an exact address to start?
documents.text:
Do you need an exact address to start?
No. A suburb, component and safe photos are enough for an initial enquiry. Access details can be agreed later.

documents.title: Carpentry questions — Can a small rotten section be repaired?
documents.text:
Can a small rotten section be repaired?
Sometimes. Sound surrounding timber and the moisture cause matter; a surface patch is not universal.

documents.title: Carpentry questions — Do you handle glass, roof leaks or electrical work?
documents.text:
Do you handle glass, roof leaks or electrical work?
Those are separate specialist scopes. The quote must accurately distinguish timber work and coordination.

documents.title: Carpentry questions — What should photos show?
documents.text:
What should photos show?
A wide view, damage and safe access. Never climb or dismantle an unsafe component for a photo.

documents.title: Carpentry questions — What will the quote include?
documents.text:
What will the quote include?
Ask for the timber work, materials, access, finishing and any removal to be identified separately. A photograph helps start the conversation, but concealed damage or site access can change the scope.

documents.title: Carpentry questions — Can we repair only the damaged part?
documents.text:
Can we repair only the damaged part?
Sometimes. The adjoining timber, fixings and cause of moisture or movement need checking first. A local repair should not hide an unstable support or an unresolved leak.

documents.title: Carpentry questions — What if hidden damage appears?
documents.text:
What if hidden damage appears?
Stop and explain the newly visible condition before extra work. Agree the changed method, materials and cost in writing rather than treating an initial photo estimate as an unlimited approval.

documents.title: Carpentry questions — How will the work affect the home?
documents.text:
How will the work affect the home?
Ask which areas need access, whether a door or window will be temporarily out of use, and what preparation, making good and waste removal are included. The answer depends on the agreed job.

documents.title: Carpentry questions — What affects the cost of a timber repair?
documents.text:
What affects the cost of a timber repair?
The damaged component, extent, safe access, material match, hardware, preparation, finishing and disposal all matter. A written quote should identify what is included and what is excluded; we cannot give one reliable price for every property.

documents.title: Carpentry questions — Who supplies materials and handles disposal?
documents.text:
Who supplies materials and handles disposal?
Confirm timber type, profile, visible finish and any hardware before ordering. Supply, removal of old material and disposal should each appear in the agreed scope; none is automatically included.

documents.title: Carpentry questions — When can work be scheduled?
documents.text:
When can work be scheduled?
Send the suburb, affected part and safe photos first. Timing depends on the assessed scope, access, materials and availability; enquiry hours are not a same-day attendance guarantee.

documents.title: Carpentry questions — How can I check the company and insurance?
documents.text:
How can I check the company and insurance?
The About page names the operating company, ABN and ACN, and describes the current insurance evidence and its limits. Ask for a current certificate if your job or property manager needs it; cover remains subject to the policy terms and confirmed work.

documents.title: 木工常见问题
documents.text:
木工常见问题
以下是判断起点；照片和现场位置可能改变维修方法与报价。

documents.title: 木工常见问题 — 一开始要提供完整地址吗？
documents.text:
一开始要提供完整地址吗？
不需要。初次询价说明所在地区、构件和安全拍摄的照片即可，详细通道可在后续确认。

documents.title: 木工常见问题 — 一小段腐木可以修吗？
documents.text:
一小段腐木可以修吗？
有可能，但剩余木材必须稳固，还要了解受潮来源；表面填补并非通用方案。

documents.title: 木工常见问题 — 玻璃、屋顶漏水或电气也做吗？
documents.text:
玻璃、屋顶漏水或电气也做吗？
这些是不同的专门范围。报价应准确区分木构件与需要其他工种配合的工作。

documents.title: 木工常见问题 — 照片应拍什么？
documents.text:
照片应拍什么？
拍全景、损坏近照和可进入位置；不要为拍照登高或拆动不稳构件。

documents.title: 木工常见问题 — 报价包含哪些工作？
documents.text:
报价包含哪些工作？
请分别确认木作、材料、通道、表面收尾及拆旧清运。照片可帮助初步沟通，但隐蔽损坏与现场通道可能改变工作范围。

documents.title: 木工常见问题 — 能只修坏掉的部分吗？
documents.text:
能只修坏掉的部分吗？
有时可以，但先要看相邻木材、固定处，以及受潮或移动的原因。局部维修不应掩盖不稳的支撑或仍在漏水的位置。

documents.title: 木工常见问题 — 拆开后发现更多损坏怎么办？
documents.text:
拆开后发现更多损坏怎么办？
增加工作前应先暂停，说明新发现的情况，再以书面确认变更后的方法、材料与费用；初步照片估算不等于无限追加工作的同意。

documents.title: 木工常见问题 — 施工会怎样影响家里？
documents.text:
施工会怎样影响家里？
可先确认需要进入哪些位置、门窗会否暂时不能使用，以及前期准备、收尾和清运包含什么；具体安排取决于同意的工作范围。

documents.title: 木工常见问题 — 木作维修费用由什么决定？
documents.text:
木作维修费用由什么决定？
受损构件、范围、安全通道、材料与五金匹配、前处理、收尾及清运都会影响费用。书面报价应列明包含和不包含的内容，不能用同一价格套所有房屋。

documents.title: 木工常见问题 — 材料与清运由谁负责？
documents.text:
材料与清运由谁负责？
订料前先确认木材种类、线条、可见饰面和五金。材料供应、拆旧及清运应逐项写进同意的工作范围，不自动视为包含。

documents.title: 木工常见问题 — 什么时候可以安排施工？
documents.text:
什么时候可以安排施工？
先提供所在地区、受损部位及安全拍摄的照片。安排时间取决于工作范围、通道、材料和可用档期；咨询时间不等于当天到场承诺。

documents.title: 木工常见问题 — 怎样核实公司和保险？
documents.text:
怎样核实公司和保险？
关于我们页面列出经营公司、ABN、ACN及现有保险证明和适用边界。若工程或物业管理方需要，可索取现行证明；具体承保仍以保单条款与确定的工作范围为准。

documents.title: Cabinet Door & Drawer Repairs in Sydney
documents.text:
Cabinet Door & Drawer Repairs in Sydney
What we can look at

documents.title: Cabinet Door & Drawer Repairs in Sydney
documents.text:
Cabinet Door & Drawer Repairs in Sydney
A dropped cupboard door or drawer that jams may be a hinge, runner, fixing point or cabinet-box problem. Identify the fitting before buying a replacement.

documents.title: Cabinet Door & Drawer Repairs in Sydney — Doors sit unevenly
documents.text:
Doors sit unevenly
Check hinge adjustment, wear and fixing strength before deciding on replacement parts. Photos of the open hinge help identify compatibility.

documents.title: Cabinet Door & Drawer Repairs in Sydney — Hinge screws no longer hold
documents.text:
Hinge screws no longer hold
Local reinforcement or fixing repair may be possible when the surrounding cabinet material is sound. Swollen or badly damaged panels may need a different solution.

documents.title: Cabinet Door & Drawer Repairs in Sydney — Drawers stick or drop
documents.text:
Drawers stick or drop
Check runner type, alignment and mounting points. Compatible runner replacement is different from rebuilding the drawer box or replacing a whole kitchen.

documents.title: Cabinet Door & Drawer Repairs in Sydney — What the damage may mean
documents.text:
What the damage may mean
Loose hinge cups, stripped screw holes, a runner that binds and a swollen cabinet panel each call for a different remedy. Photos of the open door or drawer and the visible fitting help identify what remains sound without removing an appliance.

documents.title: Cabinet Door & Drawer Repairs in Sydney — Repair, replace or investigate
documents.text:
Repair, replace or investigate
Hardware may be adjusted or replaced when compatible parts exist and the cabinet body holds a fixing. Damaged carcass material may require local reinforcement or a broader repair; if the old fitting is unavailable, alternatives need agreement before ordering.

documents.title: Cabinet Door & Drawer Repairs in Sydney — Scope and boundaries
documents.text:
Scope and boundaries
This is not a full bespoke kitchen or cabinet manufacturing offer. Dishwashers, rangehoods, plumbing and electrical equipment are outside this carpentry scope. Matching hinges, runners, door finishes and shelf materials are subject to availability.

documents.title: Cabinet Door & Drawer Repairs in Sydney — What shapes a quote
documents.text:
What shapes a quote
Send a full cabinet view, the affected door or drawer, visible fitting markings and damaged fixing holes. Part compatibility, access, number of units and finish matching affect the quote.

documents.title: Cabinet Door & Drawer Repairs in Sydney — Useful photos
documents.text:
Useful photos
Show the cabinet open and closed and the hardware marking if visible; do not remove electrical appliances.

documents.title: Cabinet Door & Drawer Repairs in Sydney — Useful photos
documents.text:
Useful photos
Do not put yourself at risk to take a photo.

documents.title: Cabinet Door & Drawer Repairs in Sydney — Real case photos: cupboard doors and hardware details
documents.text:
Real case photos: cupboard doors and hardware details
A closer look at cupboard-door edges, closing gaps and panel fixings from our real jobs. For a similar problem, send a full view of the cupboard plus close-ups of the affected edge and hardware. Surface damage, door alignment and loose fixings need separate checks before deciding what can be repaired or replaced.

documents.title: Cabinet Door & Drawer Repairs in Sydney — Check the location
documents.text:
Check the location
We take residential timber enquiries in Sydney and the selected Central Coast, Illawarra and Wollondilly locations listed in our service directory. Tell us your suburb and the work needed; we will discuss scope, access, timing and any travel charges before arranging a visit.

documents.title: Cabinet Door & Drawer Repairs in Sydney — Can just the hinges or runners be changed?
documents.text:
Can just the hinges or runners be changed?
Often, if compatible parts exist and the fixing points remain usable.

documents.title: Cabinet Door & Drawer Repairs in Sydney — What if parts cannot be matched?
documents.text:
What if parts cannot be matched?
An alternative fitting or larger repair needs a clear scope before purchase.

documents.title: Cabinet Door & Drawer Repairs in Sydney — Can the kitchen stay in place?
documents.text:
Can the kitchen stay in place?
Many local repairs can be assessed without removing the entire cabinet, subject to access.

documents.text:
悉尼柜门、铰链与抽屉维修
柜门下垂或抽屉卡住，可能是铰链、导轨、固定孔位或柜体问题；购买替换件前先认清现有配件，再决定换什么。

documents.title: 悉尼柜门、铰链与抽屉维修 — 柜门高低不齐
documents.text:
柜门高低不齐
先检查铰链调整、磨损与固定强度，再决定替换配件。打开铰链拍照有助于判断是否匹配。

documents.title: 悉尼柜门、铰链与抽屉维修 — 铰链螺丝固定不住
documents.text:
铰链螺丝固定不住
周围柜体材料稳固时，可评估局部加固或固定点修复。膨胀或严重损坏的板材可能需要其他方案。

documents.title: 悉尼柜门、铰链与抽屉维修 — 抽屉卡顿或下坠
documents.text:
抽屉卡顿或下坠
检查导轨类型、对位及安装点。更换匹配导轨，与重做抽屉箱体或更换整套厨房不同。

documents.title: 悉尼柜门、铰链与抽屉维修 — 这些损坏可能意味着什么
documents.text:
这些损坏可能意味着什么
铰链杯松动、螺丝孔滑牙、导轨卡顿与柜板受潮膨胀，各需要不同处理。拍门或抽屉开启状态以及看得到的配件，可判断哪些部分还稳固，而不必拆下旁边的电器。

documents.text:

拍开启及关闭状态和可见五金型号，不要拆电器。

documents.title: Deck Repairs & Board Replacement in Sydney
documents.text:
Deck Repairs & Board Replacement in Sydney
What we can look at

documents.title: Deck Repairs & Board Replacement in Sydney
documents.text:
Deck Repairs & Board Replacement in Sydney
Loose or rotten deck boards may be a surface repair, but a soft area or moving balustrade calls for a closer look at the supporting structure before anyone walks on it.

documents.title: Deck Repairs & Board Replacement in Sydney — Split or soft deck boards
documents.text:
Split or soft deck boards
Assess individual board replacement alongside the supporting timber below. Board size, spacing and the condition of neighbouring boards affect the repair.

documents.title: Deck Repairs & Board Replacement in Sydney — Loose boards or raised fixings
documents.text:
Loose boards or raised fixings
Check why the fixing has moved and whether its support remains sound. Simply fastening into damaged timber can leave the underlying problem unresolved.

documents.title: Deck Repairs & Board Replacement in Sydney — Repair before sanding or coating
documents.text:
Repair before sanding or coating
Separate necessary timber repairs from optional surface work. Hidden frame damage or structural changes need assessment beyond a cosmetic refresh.

documents.title: Deck Repairs & Board Replacement in Sydney — What the damage may mean
documents.text:
What the damage may mean
Splintering boards, raised fixings and local decay can sometimes be dealt with board by board. Bounce, extensive softness or movement at a rail may point below the surface. Keep off any unstable area and describe it from a safe position.

documents.title: Deck Repairs & Board Replacement in Sydney — Repair, replace or investigate
documents.text:
Repair, replace or investigate
Check the visible frame, fixings, drainage and board condition before choosing a local replacement. A sound frame permits a different scope from damaged bearers or posts; structural repair or a full rebuild requires verified capability and site conditions.

documents.title: Deck Repairs & Board Replacement in Sydney — Scope and boundaries
documents.text:
Scope and boundaries
Cleaning, sanding and oiling alone are distinct from a repair and are not included automatically. Composite systems, load-bearing frame changes and balustrades need their own assessment and qualification boundaries. Never remove boards for a quote photo.

documents.title: Deck Repairs & Board Replacement in Sydney — What shapes a quote
documents.text:
What shapes a quote
Send safe wide views, damaged boards, visible supports and dimensions. Timber matching, hidden damage, access, disposal and finishing determine the written scope.

documents.text:

If the supporting frame is sound and compatible boards are available, that may be practical.

documents.title: 悉尼Deck维修与木板更换 — Deck木板开裂或发软
documents.text:
Deck木板开裂或发软
评估个别木板更换时，同时检查下方支撑。板材尺寸、间距及相邻木板状态都会影响维修。

documents.title: 悉尼Deck维修与木板更换 — 木板松动或固定件凸起
documents.text:
木板松动或固定件凸起
检查固定件为何移位，以及支撑是否稳固。直接固定到受损木材上，可能仍留下原有问题。

documents.title: 悉尼Deck维修与木板更换 — 打磨或涂层前先维修
documents.text:
打磨或涂层前先维修
把必要的木材维修与可选表面工作分开。隐蔽框架损坏或结构改动，需要超出外观翻新的评估。

documents.title: 悉尼Deck维修与木板更换 — 这些损坏可能意味着什么
documents.text:
这些损坏可能意味着什么
面板开裂、固定件翘起及局部腐烂，有时可逐块修换。但明显弹动、大面积松软或护栏移动，可能说明下方支撑出了问题。请从安全位置说明情况，不要踏入不稳区域。

documents.title: 悉尼Deck维修与木板更换 — 维修、更换或先查原因
documents.text:
维修、更换或先查原因
先看可见底架、固定件、排水和面板状态，再决定局部更换。底架完好与承重梁柱受损是两种不同工程；结构修复或整体重建须另行核实能力和现场条件。

documents.title: 悉尼Deck维修与木板更换 — 工作范围与边界
documents.text:
工作范围与边界
单纯清洗、打磨或刷油不等于Deck维修，也不会自动包含。复合材料专门系统、承重底架改动和护栏需分别评估资格与范围；不要为了报价自行拆板。

documents.title: 悉尼Deck维修与木板更换 — 哪些因素影响报价
documents.text:
哪些因素影响报价
从安全处提供全景、坏板、可见支撑和大致尺寸。木材匹配、隐藏损坏、通道、清运及收尾决定书面范围。

documents.title: 悉尼Deck维修与木板更换 — 哪些照片有帮助
documents.text:
哪些照片有帮助
站在稳固位置拍照，不要踩软板或自行掀开面板。

documents.title: 悉尼Deck维修与木板更换 — 能否只换坏掉的木板？
documents.text:

底架稳固且能找到合适材料时，可考虑局部更换。

documents.title: 悉尼Deck维修与木板更换 — 底架是否也要检查？

尤其在面板发软或固定件反复松动时，应一并评估。

documents.text:
Timber Fascia, Eaves & Bargeboard Repairs in Sydney
What we can look at

documents.title: Timber Fascia, Eaves & Bargeboard Repairs in Sydney
documents.text:
Timber Fascia, Eaves & Bargeboard Repairs in Sydney
The timber behind a gutter, a bargeboard and an eaves lining are not the same component. Identifying the material and source of damage is the first step.

documents.title: Timber Fascia, Eaves & Bargeboard Repairs in Sydney — Local fascia damage
documents.text:
Local fascia damage
A damaged timber section may be replaced if the adjoining timber and fixing points are sound. Access height and safe working space affect the method and quote.

documents.title: Timber Fascia, Eaves & Bargeboard Repairs in Sydney — Decay near a gutter
documents.text:
Decay near a gutter
Check whether water is still reaching the timber. Timber repair and work on the gutter or roof are different tasks and should be identified separately.

documents.title: Timber Fascia, Eaves & Bargeboard Repairs in Sydney — Matching the visible edge
documents.text:
Matching the visible edge
Confirm the board profile, joints and paint finish before work. Non-timber sheets or suspected hazardous materials need appropriate specialist assessment.

documents.title: Timber Fascia, Eaves & Bargeboard Repairs in Sydney — What the damage may mean
documents.text:
What the damage may mean
Paint peeling at a roof edge, soft fascia behind the gutter or a damaged bargeboard calls for a close look at the timber and water path. An eaves lining may not be timber at all, so a photograph of the whole roof edge matters more than a guessed component name.

documents.title: Timber Fascia, Eaves & Bargeboard Repairs in Sydney — Repair, replace or investigate
documents.text:
Repair, replace or investigate
A short sound-ended length of timber may be replaceable, but access, fixings and the adjoining roof edge change the method. Ongoing overflow or roof leakage needs diagnosis by the relevant trade before new timber is left exposed to the same moisture.

documents.title: Timber Fascia, Eaves & Bargeboard Repairs in Sydney — Scope and boundaries
documents.text:
Scope and boundaries
This is a timber-component scope, not a roof-leak or gutter-repair claim. Suspected asbestos-containing eaves material must not be disturbed as ordinary carpentry; obtain an appropriate assessment. Do not climb a ladder or roof to take quote photos.

documents.title: Timber Fascia, Eaves & Bargeboard Repairs in Sydney — What shapes a quote
documents.text:
What shapes a quote
Ground-level views of the full edge, damaged section, gutter junction and safe access help define scaffold or access needs, timber profile, gutter coordination and finishing.

documents.title: Timber Fascia, Eaves & Bargeboard Repairs in Sydney — Useful photos
documents.text:

Take a wide roof-edge view and a zoomed view from safe ground level only.

documents.title: Timber Fascia, Eaves & Bargeboard Repairs in Sydney — Useful photos

documents.text:

Fascia supports the roof-edge trim, bargeboards run at a gable edge, and eaves lining may be another material.

documents.title: Timber Fascia, Eaves & Bargeboard Repairs in Sydney — Can one fascia section be replaced?
documents.text:

Possibly, if sound ends and safe access can be established.

It is a separate scope and should be identified in the written quote.

documents.title: 悉尼屋檐木构件与檐口板维修
documents.text:
悉尼屋檐木构件与檐口板维修
排水沟后方的木质封檐板、山墙边板和屋檐底板不是同一构件。先认清材质及受损来源，再谈维修。

documents.title: 悉尼屋檐木构件与檐口板维修 — 屋檐木板局部破损
documents.text:
屋檐木板局部破损
相邻木材及固定点稳固时，可评估更换损坏段。高度与安全作业空间会影响施工方式和报价。

documents.title: 悉尼屋檐木构件与檐口板维修 — 排水槽旁木材腐朽
documents.text:
排水槽旁木材腐朽
先确认水是否仍在侵入木材。木构件维修与排水槽、屋顶本体的工作不同，应分别明确范围。

documents.title: 悉尼屋檐木构件与檐口板维修 — 外露边缘与收尾
documents.text:
外露边缘与收尾
开工前确认木板轮廓、接缝和漆面。非木质板材或疑似危险材料需要相应专业评估。

documents.title: 悉尼屋檐木构件与檐口板维修 — 这些损坏可能意味着什么
documents.text:
这些损坏可能意味着什么
屋顶边缘掉漆、排水沟后木板变软，或山墙封边板破损，都需要看木材状态和水流路径。屋檐底板未必是木材；比起猜名称，拍到整个屋顶边缘与受损位置更有助于判断。

documents.title: 悉尼屋檐木构件与檐口板维修 — 维修、更换或先查原因
documents.text:
维修、更换或先查原因
若两端木材稳固，短段木构件可能可以更换，但固定方式、通道及相邻屋顶构件会影响施工。若排水沟溢流或屋顶继续漏水，应先由相应工种查明来源，避免新木材再次受潮。

documents.title: 悉尼屋檐木构件与檐口板维修 — 工作范围与边界
documents.text:
工作范围与边界
这里讨论木构件，不承诺处理屋顶漏水或排水沟本体。疑似含石棉的屋檐材料不可当普通木工板拆动，应先找合适专业人员评估；客户不需要爬梯或上屋顶拍照。

documents.title: 悉尼屋檐木构件与檐口板维修 — 哪些因素影响报价
documents.text:
哪些因素影响报价
请从地面拍屋檐整段、破损部位、排水沟接口及可进入位置。脚手架或其他安全作业设备、木材线型、天沟工程协调和表面收尾都会影响报价范围。

documents.title: 悉尼屋檐木构件与檐口板维修 — 哪些照片有帮助
documents.text:
哪些照片有帮助
只从安全地面拍全景及拉近的局部，不要登高。

documents.title: 悉尼屋檐木构件与檐口板维修 — 确认所在地区

documents.title: 悉尼屋檐木构件与檐口板维修 — 损坏的是哪种屋檐构件？
documents.text:
损坏的是哪种屋檐构件？
封檐板支承屋顶边缘的收边，山墙边板沿山墙边缘设置，屋檐底板则可能使用其他材料。

documents.title: 悉尼屋檐木构件与檐口板维修 — 能否只换一段封檐板？
documents.text:
能否只换一段封檐板？
要看两端是否完好以及能否安全进入现场。

documents.title: 悉尼屋檐木构件与檐口板维修 — 是否包含排水沟或屋顶工作？
documents.text:
是否包含排水沟或屋顶工作？
属于不同工作范围，应在书面报价中分别确认。

documents.title: Interior Carpentry & Timber Trims in Sydney
documents.text:
Interior Carpentry & Timber Trims in Sydney
What we can look at

documents.title: Interior Carpentry & Timber Trims in Sydney
documents.text:
Interior Carpentry & Timber Trims in Sydney
Damaged skirting, architraves and interior timber trims need a careful match to the room—not a generic strip of timber attached over the old profile.

documents.title: Interior Carpentry & Timber Trims in Sydney — Damaged skirting or architraves
documents.text:
Damaged skirting or architraves
Discuss a local section or length replacement, including the closest available profile and how joints will meet the existing trim.

documents.title: Interior Carpentry & Timber Trims in Sydney — Loose shelves or timber fittings
documents.text:
Loose shelves or timber fittings
Check the fixing surface and intended load before agreeing repairs. The wall or cabinet behind the fitting matters as much as the visible timber.

documents.title: Interior Carpentry & Timber Trims in Sydney — Several small indoor jobs
documents.text:
Several small indoor jobs
List each repair and photograph the surrounding area so the work can be discussed together. Confirm painting, wall patching and removal rather than assuming they are included.

documents.title: Interior Carpentry & Timber Trims in Sydney — What the damage may mean
documents.text:
What the damage may mean
A swollen skirting board, broken door trim, loose shelf or several small finishing jobs each have different fixings and surfaces behind them. A photograph of the entire run and a profile close-up helps separate replacement timber from wall patching.

documents.title: Interior Carpentry & Timber Trims in Sydney — Repair, replace or investigate
documents.text:
Repair, replace or investigate
A local section may be repaired or replaced if the profile can be matched and the substrate is sound. For a loose or replacement shelf, the bracket or cabinet support, span, expected load and fixing surface need checking before a method is chosen. Several small items can be scoped together, but material supply, access to occupied rooms and any wet-wall source should be discussed before scheduling.

documents.title: Interior Carpentry & Timber Trims in Sydney — Scope and boundaries
documents.text:
Scope and boundaries
This is not a promise of whole-house bespoke joinery, structural alteration, floor sanding or antique furniture restoration. Shelf installation is subject to the actual fixing and load scope being approved; cabinet hinges and drawers have a separate service. Wall patching and painting are not automatically included.

documents.title: Interior Carpentry & Timber Trims in Sydney — What shapes a quote
documents.text:
What shapes a quote
Show the full trim length, an end/profile view, damaged section and adjacent wall. For shelves, show existing supports, approximate width/depth and the surface they fix to. Quantity, lengths, profile availability, material supply, fixing access, patching and painting affect the estimate.

documents.title: Interior Carpentry & Timber Trims in Sydney — Useful photos
documents.text:

Include a full run and profile detail with an approximate length; do not pull off a sound trim for a photo.

documents.title: Interior Carpentry & Timber Trims in Sydney — Useful photos
documents.text:
Useful photos
Do not put yourself at risk to take a photo.

documents.title: Interior Carpentry & Timber Trims in Sydney — Real case photos: interior panels during finishing
documents.text:

These detached panels were photographed during surface work. For panel repainting, material, old coating, preparation, colour and refitting should be agreed in the written scope. This is not a whole-home painting offer.

documents.title: Interior Carpentry & Timber Trims in Sydney — Check the location
documents.text:
Check the location
We take residential timber enquiries in Sydney and the selected Central Coast, Illawarra and Wollondilly locations listed in our service directory. Tell us your suburb and the work needed; we will discuss scope, access, timing and any travel charges before arranging a visit.

documents.title: Interior Carpentry & Timber Trims in Sydney — Can the existing profile be matched?
documents.text:
Can the existing profile be matched?
Availability and the shape of the old trim determine whether a close match is possible.

documents.title: Interior Carpentry & Timber Trims in Sydney — Can several small jobs be quoted together?
documents.text:
Can several small jobs be quoted together?
Yes, describe each item and its location for one scope review.

documents.title: Interior Carpentry & Timber Trims in Sydney — Is painting included?
documents.text:
Is painting included?
Only when making good and painting are listed in the agreed work.

documents.title: Interior Carpentry & Timber Trims in Sydney — Can a loose wardrobe or timber shelf be repaired?
documents.text:
Can a loose wardrobe or timber shelf be repaired?
It depends on its support, fixings and load. Describe whether it sits in a cabinet or fixes to a wall; a safe method and service scope must be confirmed.

documents.title: 悉尼室内木作与踢脚线门套
documents.text:
悉尼室内木作与踢脚线门套
踢脚线、门套线及室内木饰条损坏时，线型与相邻墙面都值得看清，不能随意用一根普通木条盖上。

documents.title: 悉尼室内木作与踢脚线门套 — 踢脚线或门套线破损
documents.text:
踢脚线或门套线破损
可讨论局部或整段更换，包括可取得的相近线型，以及与原有饰条的接缝方式。

documents.title: 悉尼室内木作与踢脚线门套 — 层板或室内木件松动
documents.text:
层板或室内木件松动
确认维修前，先看固定基层及预计承重。背后的墙体或柜体和可见木件同样重要。

documents.title: 悉尼室内木作与踢脚线门套 — 多项室内小维修
documents.text:
多项室内小维修
列明每项问题并拍下周围位置，方便一起讨论。刷漆、墙面修补和清运应明确确认，不默认全部包含。

documents.title: 悉尼室内木作与踢脚线门套 — 这些损坏可能意味着什么
documents.text:
这些损坏可能意味着什么
受潮膨胀的踢脚线、断裂的门套、松动层板与多处小收尾工作，固定方式及背后基层各不相同。整段照片加上线条截面近照，可帮助区分需要换木材，还是同时涉及墙面修补。

documents.title: 悉尼室内木作与踢脚线门套 — 维修、更换或先查原因
documents.text:
维修、更换或先查原因
若基层稳固且能匹配线型，可评估局部修补或分段更换。层板松动或更换时，还需看托架或柜体支撑、跨度、预期承重与固定基层，才能选择处理方法。几处小活可以一起描述，但材料由谁提供、住用房间的通道及墙面受潮来源，应在安排前确认。

documents.title: 悉尼室内木作与踢脚线门套 — 工作范围与边界
documents.text:
工作范围与边界
这里不默认整屋定制木作、结构改动、地板打磨或古董家具修复。层板安装须按实际固定及承重范围批准；柜门铰链与抽屉另有对应服务。墙面补洞和油漆不能未经说明就算在报价里。

documents.title: 悉尼室内木作与踢脚线门套 — 哪些因素影响报价
documents.text:
哪些因素影响报价
拍整段长度、端面线型、受损处及相邻墙面。层板则说明现有支撑、约略宽深及固定墙面或柜体。数量、长度、材料供应、线型库存、固定通道、修补和油漆会影响估价。

documents.title: 悉尼室内木作与踢脚线门套 — 哪些照片有帮助
documents.text:
哪些照片有帮助
拍全段和侧面线型，说明大致长度；不必拆下完好线条。

documents.title: 悉尼室内木作与踢脚线门套 — 真实案例照片：室内板件表面处理
documents.text:
真实案例照片：室内板件表面处理
这些拆下的板件记录了表面处理阶段。板件刷漆翻新须把材料、旧漆、打磨准备、颜色与重新安装写进同意的范围；这不等于整屋刷漆服务。

documents.title: 悉尼室内木作与踢脚线门套 — 确认所在地区
documents.text:
确认所在地区
我们承接悉尼及服务目录中列出的 Central Coast、Illawarra 与 Wollondilly 指定地区的住宅木作询价。请说明所在地区和所需工作；安排上门前先沟通范围、通道、时间及是否涉及出行费用。

documents.title: 悉尼室内木作与踢脚线门套 — 能匹配原来的线条吗？
documents.text:
能匹配原来的线条吗？
要看旧线型形状和可购材料，才能判断匹配程度。

documents.title: 悉尼室内木作与踢脚线门套 — 几处小活能一起报价吗？
documents.text:
几处小活能一起报价吗？
可以把每件事和位置分别说明，便于合并界定范围。

documents.title: 悉尼室内木作与踢脚线门套 — 刷漆包含吗？
documents.text:
刷漆包含吗？
只有补墙与油漆写入同意的工作范围时才包含。

documents.title: 悉尼室内木作与踢脚线门套 — 衣柜或木层板松了能修吗？
documents.text:
衣柜或木层板松了能修吗？
要看支撑、固定件与承重；请说明层板在柜内还是固定在墙上，安全做法和服务范围都需确认。

documents.title: Rotten Timber Repairs in Sydney
documents.text:
Rotten Timber Repairs in Sydney
What we can look at

documents.title: Rotten Timber Repairs in Sydney
documents.text:
Rotten Timber Repairs in Sydney
When the damaged component is unclear or decay appears in several places, first map the timber, moisture and load path. A small surface patch is not always a durable repair.

documents.title: Rotten Timber Repairs in Sydney — Decay in one small area
documents.text:
Decay in one small area
Assess how far the damage extends before choosing a local repair or replacement section. A hard-looking surface does not prove the timber underneath is sound.

documents.title: Rotten Timber Repairs in Sydney — Several damaged timber parts
documents.text:
Several damaged timber parts
Identify each affected component and prioritise unstable or exposed areas. A window, door, fence or deck may need a different repair approach.

documents.title: Rotten Timber Repairs in Sydney — Damage that keeps returning
documents.text:
Damage that keeps returning
Discuss the moisture source as well as the timber. Structural concerns or an unresolved leak may need another trade before the timber work can be agreed.

documents.title: Rotten Timber Repairs in Sydney — What the damage may mean
documents.text:
What the damage may mean
Soft spots, fungal staining and paint that lifts from damp timber may appear around windows, doors, decks or fences. This page helps identify an unknown or multi-location problem; a clearly identified component has its own service page with more specific decisions.

documents.title: Rotten Timber Repairs in Sydney — Repair, replace or investigate
documents.text:
Repair, replace or investigate
Probe the extent only through a safe professional inspection, then ask whether sound timber remains for a local splice or replacement. The source of water must be addressed separately. Concealed damage may change the agreed work once safely exposed. Confirm the revised scope and cost before adding work for newly exposed damage.

documents.title: Rotten Timber Repairs in Sydney — Scope and boundaries
documents.text:
Scope and boundaries
Timber repair is not termite eradication, waterproofing diagnosis or automatic structural beam work. Load-bearing or unstable components need the right qualified assessment. Do not scrape, dismantle or step on suspect timber to collect images.

documents.title: Rotten Timber Repairs in Sydney — What shapes a quote
documents.text:
What shapes a quote
Photograph where the timber sits, the damaged surface, nearby moisture marks and any known leak repair. The location, access, hidden extent, material match and finishing determine the quote.

documents.title: Rotten Timber Repairs in Sydney — Useful photos
documents.text:
Useful photos
Show the whole location and close damage from a safe position; do not carry out destructive testing.

documents.title: Rotten Timber Repairs in Sydney — Useful photos
documents.text:
Useful photos
Do not put yourself at risk to take a photo.

documents.title: Rotten Timber Repairs in Sydney — Check the location
documents.text:
Check the location
We take residential timber enquiries in Sydney and the selected Central Coast, Illawarra and Wollondilly locations listed in our service directory. Tell us your suburb and the work needed; we will discuss scope, access, timing and any travel charges before arranging a visit.

documents.title: Rotten Timber Repairs in Sydney — Repair or replace the timber?
documents.text:
Repair or replace the timber?
That depends on how much sound material remains and whether the moisture cause is controlled.

documents.title: Rotten Timber Repairs in Sydney — What if more damage is uncovered?
documents.text:
What if more damage is uncovered?
The scope and price should be revisited before extra work is undertaken.

documents.title: Rotten Timber Repairs in Sydney — Is the moisture source included?
documents.text:
Is the moisture source included?
It may need another trade and must be stated separately.

documents.title: 悉尼腐木修复与损坏木材更换
documents.text:
悉尼腐木修复与损坏木材更换
损坏部位不明或多处木材腐烂时，先辨认构件、受潮原因和承重关系；表面补胶并不一定是耐久的修复。

documents.title: 悉尼腐木修复与损坏木材更换 — 小范围腐朽
documents.text:
小范围腐朽
先判断损坏深度和范围，再选择局部修补或更换。表面看起来坚硬，不代表内部木材仍稳固。

documents.title: 悉尼腐木修复与损坏木材更换 — 多处木材同时损坏
documents.text:
多处木材同时损坏
逐处确认受影响的构件，优先评估不稳或持续暴露的位置。木窗、门框、围栏与Deck可能需要不同处理方式。

documents.title: 悉尼腐木修复与损坏木材更换 — 修过仍反复出现
documents.text:
修过仍反复出现
除了木材本身，也要讨论受潮来源。结构问题或未解决的漏水可能需其他工种先处理，再确定木作范围。

documents.title: 悉尼腐木修复与损坏木材更换 — 这些损坏可能意味着什么
documents.text:
这些损坏可能意味着什么
发软、霉斑及受潮后起皮的油漆，可能出现在窗、门、Deck或围栏。这里帮助分流尚未确定部位或多处腐木的问题；如果已经知道是某个构件，具体服务页会解释更准确的修换判断。

documents.title: 悉尼腐木修复与损坏木材更换 — 维修、更换或先查原因
documents.text:
维修、更换或先查原因
应在安全的专业检查中界定腐烂范围，判断是否仍有稳固木材可供局部接补或更换。受潮来源需要另外处理；打开遮盖后才发现的损坏，应在增加工作前重新确认范围与费用。

documents.title: 悉尼腐木修复与损坏木材更换 — 工作范围与边界
documents.text:
工作范围与边界
木材修复不等于白蚁防治、防水诊断或自动承接承重梁柱工程。承重或不稳的构件需合适资格人员评估；拍照时不要刮擦、拆板或踩踏可疑木材。

documents.title: 悉尼腐木修复与损坏木材更换 — 哪些因素影响报价
documents.text:
哪些因素影响报价
提供木材所在位置、破损近照、周边受潮痕迹及已知的漏水维修记录。通道、隐藏范围、材料匹配和油漆收尾都会影响报价。

documents.title: 悉尼腐木修复与损坏木材更换 — 哪些照片有帮助
documents.text:
哪些照片有帮助
从安全位置拍整体与近照，不要自行做破坏性探测。

documents.title: 悉尼腐木修复与损坏木材更换 — 确认所在地区
documents.text:
确认所在地区
我们承接悉尼及服务目录中列出的 Central Coast、Illawarra 与 Wollondilly 指定地区的住宅木作询价。请说明所在地区和所需工作；安排上门前先沟通范围、通道、时间及是否涉及出行费用。

documents.title: 悉尼腐木修复与损坏木材更换 — 腐木应修还是换？
documents.text:
腐木应修还是换？
取决于还剩多少稳固木材，以及受潮来源是否已受控制。

documents.title: 悉尼腐木修复与损坏木材更换 — 受潮来源也包含吗？
documents.text:
受潮来源也包含吗？
可能需其他工种处理，须在报价中另行注明。

documents.title: Timber Door & Door Frame Repairs in Sydney
documents.text:
Timber Door & Door Frame Repairs in Sydney
What we can look at

documents.title: Timber Door & Door Frame Repairs in Sydney
documents.text:
Timber Door & Door Frame Repairs in Sydney
A door that rubs, drops or will not latch may need an adjustment rather than a new door. Rot at the jamb or threshold is a different repair and needs the affected timber checked.

documents.title: Timber Door & Door Frame Repairs in Sydney — A door rubs or will not latch
documents.text:
A door rubs or will not latch
Hinge fixing, door alignment and the latch position can be checked before replacing the door. Movement or moisture in the frame may need attention first.

documents.title: Timber Door & Door Frame Repairs in Sydney — A damaged jamb or threshold
documents.text:
A damaged jamb or threshold
A local timber repair may retain the sound parts of the frame. The extent of decay and the surrounding fixing points determine whether a larger section needs replacing.

documents.title: Timber Door & Door Frame Repairs in Sydney — Keeping the existing door
documents.text:
Keeping the existing door
Discuss re-hanging and compatible hardware where the leaf remains usable. Confirm any painting and making good separately; fire doors and lockout services are outside this repair scope.

documents.title: Timber Door & Door Frame Repairs in Sydney — What the damage may mean
documents.text:
What the damage may mean
A timber door can catch at the floor, miss its latch or reveal a soft lower jamb. The gap pattern, hinge fixing and threshold help distinguish a hanging issue from decay or movement in the frame. Avoid forcing an unstable door just to demonstrate it.

documents.title: Timber Door & Door Frame Repairs in Sydney — Repair, replace or investigate
documents.text:
Repair, replace or investigate
A sound door may be rehung or have hardware adjusted; limited damage to a jamb or threshold may be replaced locally. If the surrounding frame, wall or moisture source is compromised, the work may need a larger scope and another trade before a repair is agreed.

documents.title: Timber Door & Door Frame Repairs in Sydney — Scope and boundaries
documents.text:
Scope and boundaries
Fire-rated doors, emergency lockouts, automatic doors, glass doors and aluminium sliding tracks are not assumed to be ordinary timber-door repairs. New door installation is a separate conditional scope. Finishing and hardware supply are quoted explicitly.

documents.title: Timber Door & Door Frame Repairs in Sydney — What shapes a quote
documents.text:
What shapes a quote
Show the whole door closed, hinge and latch sides, threshold and damaged corners. Door size, profile matching, frame condition, hardware, access and finishing influence the written estimate.

documents.title: Timber Door & Door Frame Repairs in Sydney — Useful photos
documents.text:
Useful photos
Take a full view, close views of jamb corners, hinges, latch and threshold without dismantling the door.

documents.title: Timber Door & Door Frame Repairs in Sydney — Useful photos
documents.text:
Useful photos
Do not put yourself at risk to take a photo.

documents.title: Timber Door & Door Frame Repairs in Sydney — When the door jamb is breaking away
documents.text:
When the door jamb is breaking away
These photos show substantial visible loss of timber beside an exterior door. Before choosing filler or a replacement length, check how far sound timber continues behind the opening, whether the door still closes and latches, and whether water is reaching the frame. A quote should state the timber to be retained or replaced, sealing and paint finish, and any separate work needed around the wall or threshold. The photos alone do not establish the cause or a completed repair.

documents.title: Timber Door & Door Frame Repairs in Sydney — When the door jamb is breaking away
documents.text:
When the door jamb is breaking away
Check the full height, not only the surface

documents.title: Timber Door & Door Frame Repairs in Sydney — What a sound door-frame repair should achieve
documents.text:
What a sound door-frame repair should achieve
A replacement jamb must have sound fixings, allow the existing door to close and latch, and have sealed joins and an agreed paint finish. The adjacent brickwork, threshold and any continuing water entry need their own checks. The image shows one possible appearance for planning; the actual repair extent depends on the property.

documents.title: Timber Door & Door Frame Repairs in Sydney — Real work photos: door and frame details
documents.text:
Real work photos: door and frame details
These images show a real work site and measured details. They do not, on their own, establish the final repair scope or outcome.

documents.title: Timber Door & Door Frame Repairs in Sydney — Real case photos: door panels, frames and latch work
documents.text:
Real case photos: door panels, frames and latch work
The door and frame photos show separate real job stages, not a before-and-after sequence. Door-leaf and frame repainting can be scoped with the timber work. Replacement of a compatible latch or lockset depends on the existing door, frame and hardware; emergency lockouts are not part of this carpentry scope.

documents.title: Timber Door & Door Frame Repairs in Sydney — Check the location
documents.text:
Check the location
We take residential timber enquiries in Sydney and the selected Central Coast, Illawarra and Wollondilly locations listed in our service directory. Tell us your suburb and the work needed; we will discuss scope, access, timing and any travel charges before arranging a visit.

documents.title: Timber Door & Door Frame Repairs in Sydney — Can a damaged jamb be repaired locally?
documents.text:
Can a damaged jamb be repaired locally?
It depends on the soundness of the adjoining frame and why it became damaged.

documents.title: Timber Door & Door Frame Repairs in Sydney — Can the existing door be kept?
documents.text:
Can the existing door be kept?
Often that is the first question to assess; a sound leaf may only need adjustment or a local frame repair.

documents.title: Timber Door & Door Frame Repairs in Sydney — What if the door does not latch?
documents.text:
What if the door does not latch?
Hinges, latch alignment and frame movement should be checked before removing timber.

documents.title: 悉尼木门与门框维修
documents.text:
悉尼木门与门框维修
木门刮地、下垂或锁不上，不一定要整扇更换；门框侧边或门槛腐烂则需要另行检查木材范围。

documents.title: 悉尼木门与门框维修 — 木门刮地或关不上
documents.text:
木门刮地或关不上
先检查铰链固定、门板位置与锁舌对位，再判断是否需要换门；门框移动或受潮可能需先处理。

documents.title: 悉尼木门与门框维修 — 门框侧边或门槛损坏
documents.text:
门框侧边或门槛损坏
局部维修可保留稳固的门框部分；腐朽范围及周围固定点决定是否要更换更大段木材。

documents.title: 悉尼木门与门框维修 — 尽量保留现有门板
documents.text:
尽量保留现有门板
门板仍可使用时，可讨论重新挂门及匹配五金。刷漆和周边修补需分别确认；防火门与开锁不属于这项维修范围。

documents.title: 悉尼木门与门框维修 — 这些损坏可能意味着什么
documents.text:
这些损坏可能意味着什么
木门可能擦地、锁舌对不上，或门框靠近地面的木材发软。门缝变化、铰链固定及门槛状况，能帮助区分挂门问题、木材腐烂与框架移动。门不稳时不要强行反复开关。

documents.title: 悉尼木门与门框维修 — 维修、更换或先查原因
documents.text:
维修、更换或先查原因
门板完好时可评估重新挂正或调整五金；局部门套或门槛损坏有时可分段更换。若相邻墙体、框架或水源受影响，必须先界定更大范围，必要时由其他工种处理来源。

documents.title: 悉尼木门与门框维修 — 工作范围与边界
documents.text:
工作范围与边界
防火门、紧急开锁、自动门、玻璃门和铝合金推拉门轨道不视为普通木门维修。新门安装是另外核实的服务；配件供应、油漆和收尾要在报价中写清楚。

documents.title: 悉尼木门与门框维修 — 哪些因素影响报价
documents.text:
哪些因素影响报价
请拍门关闭时全景、铰链侧与门闩侧、门槛及腐烂角落。门的尺寸、线条匹配、框架状况、五金、通道和收尾会影响书面报价。

documents.title: 悉尼木门与门框维修 — 哪些照片有帮助
documents.text:
哪些照片有帮助
无需拆门，拍整扇门、门框角落、铰链、门闩和门槛即可。

documents.title: 悉尼木门与门框维修 — 外门框破裂、缺损时怎么办
documents.text:
外门框破裂、缺损时怎么办
照片可见外门旁的木框有明显缺损。决定补料或分段更换前，应检查破口后方还有多少稳固木材、门能否正常关锁，以及水是否仍会接触门框。报价应写清保留或更换哪些木材、封缝与油漆收尾，以及墙边或门槛是否需要另行处理。仅凭照片不能确定成因或已完成的维修。

documents.title: 悉尼木门与门框维修 — 门框维修后应达到什么效果
documents.text:
门框维修后应达到什么效果
更换后的门框侧边应有稳固固定点，让原门能够正常关闭与上锁，接缝封好，并按约定完成涂装。相邻砖墙、门槛及持续进水也需要分别检查。图片展示一种可供规划的外观，实际维修范围仍取决于现场。

documents.title: 悉尼木门与门框维修 — 真实施工照片：门与门框细节
documents.text:
真实施工照片：门与门框细节
这些照片记录了真实施工现场和测量细节；仅凭照片不能确定最终维修范围或完成结果。

documents.title: 悉尼木门与门框维修 — 真实案例照片：门板、门框与锁舌
documents.text:

这些门板与门框照片记录不同真实施工阶段，并非一组前后对比。门板、门框刷漆翻新可与木作一起界定；更换相容门锁或锁舌须看现有门板、门框和五金，紧急开锁不属于本页木工范围。

documents.title: 悉尼木门与门框维修 — 确认所在地区
