我们承接悉尼及服务目录中列出的 Central Coast、Illawarra 与 Wollondilly 指定地区的住宅木作询价。请说明所在地区和所需工作；安排上门前先沟通范围、通道、时间及是否涉及出行费用。

documents.title: 悉尼木门与门框维修 — 门框可以局部修吗？
documents.text:
门框可以局部修吗？
需看相邻框架是否稳固，以及原先损坏的原因。

documents.title: 悉尼木门与门框维修 — 能否保留原来的木门？
documents.text:
能否保留原来的木门？
如果门板本身完好，可先评估调整门扇或局部修门框。

documents.title: 悉尼木门与门框维修 — 木门锁不上怎么办？
documents.text:
木门锁不上怎么办？
先检查铰链、锁舌对位和框架移动，不能直接假定只需刨门。

documents.title: Timber Fence Repairs & Replacement in Sydney
documents.text:
Timber Fence Repairs & Replacement in Sydney
What we can look at

documents.title: Timber Fence Repairs & Replacement in Sydney
documents.text:
Timber Fence Repairs & Replacement in Sydney
Timber fence maintenance, local repairs and section replacement in Sydney. Keep sound timber in use: assess posts, rails, palings and fixings before deciding what needs attention.

documents.title: Timber Fence Repairs & Replacement in Sydney — Fence maintenance in Sydney
documents.text:
Fence maintenance in Sydney
Mel One timber fence maintenance enquiries cover the condition of posts, rails, palings and fixings—not just how a fence looks. Tell us whether you want routine upkeep, help with a new fault or an assessment of an older fence.

documents.title: Timber Fence Repairs & Replacement in Sydney — Posts and ground level
documents.text:
Posts and ground level
Note leaning posts, soft-looking bases, soil build-up and persistent damp. Photograph from safe access; do not push or load an unstable fence.

documents.title: Timber Fence Repairs & Replacement in Sydney — Rails, palings and fixings
documents.text:
Rails, palings and fixings
Look for loose boards, split rails, gaps and rusty or missing fixings. Show the surrounding sound timber as well as the damaged part so the repair extent can be assessed.

documents.title: Timber Fence Repairs & Replacement in Sydney — Surface and surrounding growth
documents.text:
Surface and surrounding growth
Show peeling finishes, vegetation touching timber and debris near the base. Cleaning, preparation and any coating need an agreed scope; a fresh finish cannot make decayed timber structurally sound.

documents.title: Timber Fence Repairs & Replacement in Sydney — Maintenance, repair or replacement?
documents.text:
Maintenance, repair or replacement?
Upkeep is appropriate when the underlying timber and supports remain sound. A loose paling, failed fixing or isolated damaged rail may need a local repair. Multiple decayed posts, failing rails or an unstable run need assessment for section replacement rather than repeated cosmetic work.

documents.title: Timber Fence Repairs & Replacement in Sydney — Maintenance, repair or replacement?
documents.text:
Maintenance, repair or replacement?
After strong winds, heavy rain or a fallen branch, report any new lean or movement. Keep people and pets away from an unstable section. A dragging manual timber gate has its own hinge, latch and post assessment.

documents.title: Timber Fence Repairs & Replacement in Sydney — Fence maintenance costs: what to include
documents.text:
Fence maintenance costs: what to include
There is no single maintenance price for every fence. Length and height, access to each side, the number of posts or boards needing work, existing coatings, preparation and waste removal all affect scope. Separate upkeep, timber replacement and any agreed finishing in the quote so you can compare like-for-like work.

documents.title: Timber Fence Repairs & Replacement in Sydney — Fence maintenance costs: what to include
documents.text:
Fence maintenance costs: what to include
Send your suburb, approximate fence length, a full-run photo and close-ups of the affected parts. Mention shared-boundary access and whether you also need the adjoining gate checked. Availability and the work offered at your location are confirmed before booking.

documents.title: Timber Fence Repairs & Replacement in Sydney — Loose or split palings
documents.text:
Loose or split palings
Where rails and posts remain sound, individual palings and suitable fixings can be assessed for replacement without assuming the entire fence must be rebuilt.

documents.title: Timber Fence Repairs & Replacement in Sydney — Leaning posts or damaged rails
documents.text:
Leaning posts or damaged rails
Check the supporting timber and connections, not just the visible boards. A post or rail replacement may involve removing and reinstating adjoining palings.

documents.title: Timber Fence Repairs & Replacement in Sydney — Fence maintenance before refinishing
documents.text:
Fence maintenance before refinishing
Identify loose fixings, soft timber and ground contact before discussing a surface finish. Confirm preparation, coating and disposal separately in the quote.

documents.title: Timber Fence Repairs & Replacement in Sydney — What the damage may mean
documents.text:
What the damage may mean
Loose palings, a soft post base, split rails and a fence that leans are different failures. The condition on both sides of the boundary and the length of the affected run matter, particularly when removal and access are part of the job.

documents.title: Timber Fence Repairs & Replacement in Sydney — Repair, replace or investigate
documents.text:
Repair, replace or investigate
A single post or rail can sometimes be replaced while keeping sound panels. Repeated failing posts or widespread decay may make a longer section more practical. Discuss boundaries and neighbour access with the relevant owners before work is arranged.

documents.title: Timber Fence Repairs & Replacement in Sydney — Scope and boundaries
documents.text:
Scope and boundaries
This is timber fencing, not Colorbond, glass pool fencing or powered gates. Boundary ownership and cost sharing are matters for the parties and applicable advice, not a legal conclusion from a website. New full-fence installation requires separate scope approval.

documents.title: Timber Fence Repairs & Replacement in Sydney — What shapes a quote
documents.text:
What shapes a quote
Send a full-length view, post bases, rails, affected boards and both sides of the access. Height, length, timber match, disposal, ground conditions and neighbour arrangements change the estimate.

documents.title: Timber Fence Repairs & Replacement in Sydney — Useful photos
documents.text:
Useful photos
Show the complete run, post feet and both access sides without entering a neighbour’s property without permission.

documents.title: Timber Fence Repairs & Replacement in Sydney — Useful photos
documents.text:
Useful photos
Do not put yourself at risk to take a photo.

documents.title: Timber Fence Repairs & Replacement in Sydney — Real case photos: timber fence maintenance
documents.text:
Real case photos: timber fence maintenance
These real work photos show fence boards, fixings and the surrounding work area. For a similar enquiry, send a full fence view and close-ups of the affected boards, posts and rails so we can discuss local repairs, maintenance or replacement.

documents.title: Timber Fence Repairs & Replacement in Sydney — Check the location
documents.text:
Check the location
We take residential timber enquiries in Sydney and the selected Central Coast, Illawarra and Wollondilly locations listed in our service directory. Tell us your suburb and the work needed; we will discuss scope, access, timing and any travel charges before arranging a visit.

documents.title: Timber Fence Repairs & Replacement in Sydney — Can one post be replaced?
documents.text:
Can one post be replaced?
Often a sound surrounding run can be kept, but the footing and rails must be checked.

documents.title: Timber Fence Repairs & Replacement in Sydney — Is old timber removal included?
documents.text:
Is old timber removal included?
Removal and disposal should appear explicitly in the quote.

documents.title: Timber Fence Repairs & Replacement in Sydney — What access is needed?
documents.text:
What access is needed?
Both sides and any neighbour access need confirming before scheduling. The method can affect the scope; confirm boundary arrangements as well.

documents.title: 悉尼木围栏维修与更换
documents.text:
悉尼木围栏维修与更换
悉尼木围栏保养、局部维修与分段更换。先检查立柱、横梁、木板与连接处，保留仍稳固的木材，再确定哪些部位需要处理。

documents.title: 悉尼木围栏维修与更换 — 悉尼木围栏保养
documents.text:
悉尼木围栏保养
Mel One 木围栏保养询价关注立柱、横梁、木板和固定件的状况，而不只是外观。请说明是日常维护、新出现的故障，还是希望评估旧围栏。

documents.title: 悉尼木围栏维修与更换 — 立柱与地面
documents.text:
立柱与地面
留意立柱倾斜、柱脚疑似腐烂、积土及长期潮湿。从安全位置拍照，不要推压或倚靠不稳的围栏。

documents.title: 悉尼木围栏维修与更换 — 横梁、木板与固定件
documents.text:
横梁、木板与固定件
查看木板松动、横梁开裂、缝隙及固定件锈蚀或缺失。照片同时拍到附近完好的木材及受损部分，方便判断维修范围。

documents.title: 悉尼木围栏维修与更换 — 表面与周边植物
documents.text:
表面与周边植物
拍下表面涂层剥落、植物贴住木材及柱脚周边杂物的情况。清洁、前处理及涂层须另行明确；刷漆不能恢复腐烂木材的结构强度。

documents.title: 悉尼木围栏维修与更换 — 保养、维修还是更换？
documents.text:
保养、维修还是更换？
木材及支撑仍稳固时，才适合以保养为主。个别木板松动、固定件失效或单根横梁损坏，可评估局部维修。多根柱腐烂、横梁失效或整段不稳，应评估分段更换，不能反复只处理外观。

documents.title: 悉尼木围栏维修与更换 — 保养、维修还是更换？
documents.text:
保养、维修还是更换？
强风、大雨或树枝落下后，如出现新的倾斜或移动，请说明变化。让人和宠物远离不稳部分。手动木闸门刮地则需另看铰链、门闩及门柱。

documents.title: 悉尼木围栏维修与更换 — 木围栏保养费用：报价需要哪些内容
documents.text:
木围栏保养费用：报价需要哪些内容
围栏保养不能用一个统一价格套所有现场。长度、高度、两侧通道、需处理的柱或木板数量、旧涂层、前处理及清运都会影响范围。报价应区分保养、木材更换及同意的表面处理，方便比较同等工作。

documents.title: 悉尼木围栏维修与更换 — 木围栏保养费用：报价需要哪些内容
documents.text:
木围栏保养费用：报价需要哪些内容
请提供所在地区、大致长度、整段照片及受影响部位近照，并说明共用边界通道、是否还需检查相连木闸门。预约前确认当地可承接范围和时间。

documents.title: 悉尼木围栏维修与更换 — 围栏木板松动或开裂
documents.text:
围栏木板松动或开裂
横梁与立柱仍稳固时，可评估个别木板及合适固定件的更换，不必直接假定整段围栏都要重建。

documents.title: 悉尼木围栏维修与更换 — 立柱倾斜或横梁损坏
documents.text:
立柱倾斜或横梁损坏
不只看表面的木板，也要检查支撑木材和连接处。更换立柱或横梁可能需要拆装相邻木板。

documents.title: 悉尼木围栏维修与更换 — 围栏保养与表面翻新
documents.text:
围栏保养与表面翻新
讨论表面收尾前，先确认松动固定件、发软木材及接地位置。前处理、涂层与清运应在报价中分别说明。

documents.title: 悉尼木围栏维修与更换 — 这些损坏可能意味着什么
documents.text:
这些损坏可能意味着什么
围栏木板松动、柱脚发软、横梁裂开与整段倾斜，是不同的损坏。受影响长度以及边界两侧的状况也很重要，尤其是拆旧、清运和进入现场都可能成为实际工作的一部分。

documents.title: 悉尼木围栏维修与更换 — 维修、更换或先查原因
documents.text:
维修、更换或先查原因
周边围栏稳固时，有时只需更换立柱或横梁；若多根柱都失效或腐烂蔓延，更长一段更换可能合理。施工安排前，边界及邻居通道应由相关业主先行确认。

documents.title: 悉尼木围栏维修与更换 — 工作范围与边界
documents.text:
工作范围与边界
这里是木围栏，不是Colorbond、玻璃泳池围栏或电动门。网站不能替代产权和费用分摊的个案法律意见；新建整排围栏属于另行核实的工作范围。

documents.title: 悉尼木围栏维修与更换 — 哪些因素影响报价
documents.text:
哪些因素影响报价
拍整段围栏、柱脚、横梁、坏板及两侧可进入情况。高度、长度、木材匹配、清运、地面状况和邻里安排都会影响报价。

documents.title: 悉尼木围栏维修与更换 — 哪些照片有帮助
documents.text:
哪些照片有帮助
拍整段、柱脚和通道；未经同意不要进入邻居土地。

documents.title: 悉尼木围栏维修与更换 — 真实案例照片：木围栏保养与维修
documents.text:
真实案例照片：木围栏保养与维修
这些真实施工照片展示围栏木板、固定细节与周边工作区域。如需类似服务，请提供围栏全景，以及受损木板、立柱和横梁近照，方便讨论局部维修、保养或更换。

documents.title: 悉尼木围栏维修与更换 — 确认所在地区
documents.text:
确认所在地区
我们承接悉尼及服务目录中列出的 Central Coast、Illawarra 与 Wollondilly 指定地区的住宅木作询价。请说明所在地区和所需工作；安排上门前先沟通范围、通道、时间及是否涉及出行费用。

documents.title: 悉尼木围栏维修与更换 — 能否只换一根木柱？
documents.text:
能否只换一根木柱？
若周边结构稳固可评估，但柱脚和横梁仍需检查。

documents.title: 悉尼木围栏维修与更换 — 报价包括拆旧清运吗？
documents.text:
报价包括拆旧清运吗？
拆除与清运应在书面范围里明确，而不能自动假定包含。

documents.title: 悉尼木围栏维修与更换 — 两边都要能进入吗？
documents.text:
两边都要能进入吗？
视工法而定，安排前应先确认围栏两侧、任何邻居通道及边界安排。

documents.title: Timber Gate Repairs in Sydney
documents.text:
Timber Gate Repairs in Sydney
What we can look at

documents.title: Timber Gate Repairs in Sydney
documents.text:
Timber Gate Repairs in Sydney
A manual timber side gate that drags or will not latch might need hinges, a post, the latch or the gate leaf assessed—not necessarily an entirely new gate.

documents.title: Timber Gate Repairs in Sydney — A gate drags on the ground
documents.text:
A gate drags on the ground
Check the post, hinges and gate frame before adjusting clearance. Re-hanging alone may not solve a moving post or a distorted frame.

documents.title: Timber Gate Repairs in Sydney — Hinges or a latch work loose
documents.text:
Hinges or a latch work loose
Assess compatible replacement hardware and the timber holding its screws. New hardware needs sound fixing points to work properly.

documents.title: Timber Gate Repairs in Sydney — Damaged boards or framing
documents.text:
Damaged boards or framing
Consider local timber replacement where the rest of the manual gate is serviceable. A complete new gate, automation or pool-barrier compliance needs a separate scope.

documents.title: Timber Gate Repairs in Sydney — What the damage may mean
documents.text:
What the damage may mean
A sagging leaf, loose hinge screws, a moving timber post and a misaligned latch feel similar when the gate is shut. Views of the opening and closing position help locate the fault without forcing a gate that has become unstable.

documents.title: Timber Gate Repairs in Sydney — Repair, replace or investigate
documents.text:
Repair, replace or investigate
If the leaf is sound, rehanging or suitable hardware may solve the problem. A decayed post or rail needs timber work, and a distorted leaf may warrant replacement. The fixing substrate and access matter as much as the visible latch.

documents.title: Timber Gate Repairs in Sydney — Scope and boundaries
documents.text:
Scope and boundaries
This covers manually operated timber gates. Motors, remotes, automatic systems and pool safety certification are separate specialist matters. Hardware replacement and a whole new gate must be explicitly within an approved quote.

documents.title: Timber Gate Repairs in Sydney — What shapes a quote
documents.text:
What shapes a quote
Show the gate open and closed, the scrape point, both posts and readable hardware. Dimensions, post condition, hinge fixing and hardware availability influence the repair.

documents.title: Timber Gate Repairs in Sydney — Useful photos
documents.text:
Useful photos
Do not force an unsafe gate. Photograph both positions, the hinges, post and latch from safe access.

documents.title: Timber Gate Repairs in Sydney — Useful photos
documents.text:
Useful photos
Do not put yourself at risk to take a photo.

documents.title: Timber Gate Repairs in Sydney — Check the location
documents.text:
Check the location
We take residential timber enquiries in Sydney and the selected Central Coast, Illawarra and Wollondilly locations listed in our service directory. Tell us your suburb and the work needed; we will discuss scope, access, timing and any travel charges before arranging a visit.

documents.title: Timber Gate Repairs in Sydney — Can the existing gate be rehung?
documents.text:
Can the existing gate be rehung?
Possibly, if the leaf and fixing post remain sound.

documents.title: Timber Gate Repairs in Sydney — Is it the hinge, latch or post?
documents.text:
Is it the hinge, latch or post?
The gap and movement need checking before selecting a repair. A close-up of the latch alone cannot determine it.

documents.title: Timber Gate Repairs in Sydney — Does the quote include new hardware?
documents.text:
Does the quote include new hardware?
Only when the hardware and supply are listed in the agreed scope.

documents.title: 悉尼木闸门与花园门维修
documents.text:
悉尼木闸门与花园门维修
手动木侧门刮地或锁不上，问题可能在铰链、木柱、门闩或门扇，不必先假定整门重做。

documents.title: 悉尼木闸门与花园门维修 — 木闸门拖地
documents.text:
木闸门拖地
调整间隙前先检查门柱、铰链和门框。门柱移动或框架变形时，仅重新挂门可能无法解决问题。

documents.title: 悉尼木闸门与花园门维修 — 铰链或门扣松动
documents.text:
铰链或门扣松动
评估匹配的替换五金及螺丝固定处木材。新的五金同样需要稳固的固定点。

documents.title: 悉尼木闸门与花园门维修 — 门板或框架损坏
documents.text:
门板或框架损坏
手动木门其余部分可用时，可考虑局部木材更换。整扇新门、电动机构或泳池围栏合规需另行确认。

documents.title: 悉尼木闸门与花园门维修 — 这些损坏可能意味着什么
documents.text:
这些损坏可能意味着什么
门扇下垂、铰链螺丝松动、木门柱移动与门闩错位，关门时可能看起来很相似。提供开启和关闭状态，有助于找到故障位置；不稳的门不要为拍照而强行操作。

documents.title: 悉尼木闸门与花园门维修 — 维修、更换或先查原因
documents.text:
维修、更换或先查原因
门扇完好时，可评估重新挂门或更换合适五金；门柱或横档腐烂则需要木作处理，门扇变形时可能需要更换。固定基层和通道与可见门闩同样重要。

documents.title: 悉尼木闸门与花园门维修 — 工作范围与边界
documents.text:
工作范围与边界
本页限手动木闸门。电机、遥控、自动系统和泳池安全认证属于另行专业事项；更换五金或整套新门须有明确获准的报价范围。

documents.title: 悉尼木闸门与花园门维修 — 哪些因素影响报价
documents.text:
哪些因素影响报价
请拍开启与关闭状态、刮地位置、两侧门柱及清晰可辨的五金型号。尺寸、柱体状况、铰链固定和配件供应影响维修方案。

documents.title: 悉尼木闸门与花园门维修 — 哪些照片有帮助
documents.text:
哪些照片有帮助
门不稳时不要强开；安全位置拍门、门柱、铰链和门闩。

documents.title: 悉尼木闸门与花园门维修 — 确认所在地区
documents.text:
确认所在地区
我们承接悉尼及服务目录中列出的 Central Coast、Illawarra 与 Wollondilly 指定地区的住宅木作询价。请说明所在地区和所需工作；安排上门前先沟通范围、通道、时间及是否涉及出行费用。

documents.title: 悉尼木闸门与花园门维修 — 原来的木闸门能重新挂正吗？
documents.text:
原来的木闸门能重新挂正吗？
门扇和固定门柱稳固时，可以先评估这个选择。

documents.title: 悉尼木闸门与花园门维修 — 是铰链、门闩还是木柱的问题？
documents.text:
是铰链、门闩还是木柱的问题？
需要看缝隙与移动位置，不能只凭一张锁扣近照判断。

documents.title: 悉尼木闸门与花园门维修 — 报价包含新五金吗？
documents.text:
报价包含新五金吗？
只有列入同意的工作范围和材料清单时才包含。

documents.title: Timber Sleeper Installation & Replacement in Sydney
documents.text:
Timber Sleeper Installation & Replacement in Sydney
What we can look at

documents.title: Timber Sleeper Installation & Replacement in Sydney
documents.text:
Timber Sleeper Installation & Replacement in Sydney
Define a garden edge, replace deteriorated timber sleepers or tidy the boundary between soil and lawn. Mel One can discuss the timber, layout and fixing needed for your outdoor project.

documents.title: Timber Sleeper Installation & Replacement in Sydney — New garden borders
documents.text:
New garden borders
Set out the line, corners and finished height before choosing timber and fixings. Show how the edge meets paths, lawn and adjoining fences.

documents.title: Timber Sleeper Installation & Replacement in Sydney — Deteriorated sleeper replacement
documents.text:
Deteriorated sleeper replacement
Check the full section, not only the visible face. Confirm sound fixing points and whether removal, ground preparation and disposal are included.

documents.title: Timber Sleeper Installation & Replacement in Sydney — Edging or retaining?
documents.text:
Edging or retaining?
Explain whether the timber marks a border or holds back soil at a different level. Retaining work needs its own support and drainage assessment.

documents.title: Timber Sleeper Installation & Replacement in Sydney — What needs attention at the site
documents.text:
What needs attention at the site
A garden edge that moves, rots or lets soil spill onto a path may need more than a new top board. The existing supports, ground contact and water flow affect whether a local replacement will last. Tell us whether the timber only marks an edge or holds back a difference in ground level.

documents.title: Timber Sleeper Installation & Replacement in Sydney — Repair, replace or investigate
documents.text:
Repair, replace or investigate
For new edging, agree the line, corners, finished height and access before materials are ordered. For replacement, check the adjoining timber and fixing points as well as the damaged sleeper. Where soil is being retained, the load, support and drainage need their own assessment before a method or price is agreed.

documents.title: Timber Sleeper Installation & Replacement in Sydney — Scope and boundaries
documents.text:
Scope and boundaries
This service covers timber sleeper enquiries for garden edging and small outdoor timber projects. A retaining wall is a different scope from a simple garden border; structural design, drainage and any required approvals must be checked separately. Concrete sleepers, excavation near utilities and alterations to pool barriers are not automatically included.

documents.title: Timber Sleeper Installation & Replacement in Sydney — What shapes a quote
documents.text:
What shapes a quote
Send the approximate total length, visible height, number of corners and photos from both sides. Material choice, ground preparation, supports, access, removal of old sleepers and finishing should be itemised. An edging-only quote should not be compared with a retaining-wall quote as if they include the same work.

documents.title: Timber Sleeper Installation & Replacement in Sydney — Useful photos
documents.text:
Useful photos
Show the whole proposed line, existing sleepers and any slope, nearby paving, fence or drain. Include a rough measurement without digging or moving unstable timber.

documents.title: Timber Sleeper Installation & Replacement in Sydney — Useful photos
documents.text:
Useful photos
Do not put yourself at risk to take a photo.

documents.title: Timber Sleeper Installation & Replacement in Sydney — From our work: a timber edge beside the stairs
documents.text:
From our work: a timber edge beside the stairs
This job includes a low timber edge beside an outdoor stair, with new vertical screening around the adjoining opening. The photos show the layout during work. For sleeper installation at your home, send the proposed line, length and ground levels so edging and any retaining work can be scoped separately.

documents.title: Timber Sleeper Installation & Replacement in Sydney — From our work: a timber edge beside the stairs
documents.text:
From our work: a timber edge beside the stairs
Timber edge and adjacent screening during work

documents.title: Timber Sleeper Installation & Replacement in Sydney — Check the location
documents.text:
Check the location
We take residential timber enquiries in Sydney and the selected Central Coast, Illawarra and Wollondilly locations listed in our service directory. Tell us your suburb and the work needed; we will discuss scope, access, timing and any travel charges before arranging a visit.

documents.title: Timber Sleeper Installation & Replacement in Sydney — Can you replace just one rotten sleeper?
documents.text:
Can you replace just one rotten sleeper?
A local replacement may be suitable if the surrounding timber and supports are sound. If several pieces are soft or the ground is moving, the wider section needs checking first. This avoids merely covering the problem.

documents.title: Timber Sleeper Installation & Replacement in Sydney — Do you install timber garden edging as well as replace it?
documents.text:
Do you install timber garden edging as well as replace it?
Yes. Describe the garden border, approximate length and preferred appearance. We can discuss new timber edging or replacement and confirm the materials and work before booking.

documents.title: Timber Sleeper Installation & Replacement in Sydney — Is garden edging the same as a sleeper retaining wall?
documents.text:
Is garden edging the same as a sleeper retaining wall?
No. Edging can simply separate a lawn and garden bed. Timber that holds back a change in ground level needs assessment of the retained soil, support and drainage; do not assume the same installation method applies.

documents.title: Timber Sleeper Installation & Replacement in Sydney — Which timber should I choose?
documents.text:
Which timber should I choose?
Suitability depends on ground contact, exposure, the intended use and the available product. Confirm the timber specification and treatment suitability before purchase, especially around growing areas.

documents.title: Timber Sleeper Installation & Replacement in Sydney — Can sleeper work be quoted with fence or deck repairs?
documents.text:
Can sleeper work be quoted with fence or deck repairs?
Yes. List the separate jobs and photograph each area. The quote can distinguish edging, fence repairs, deck work and removal so you can choose which work to proceed with.

documents.title: 悉尼木 Sleeper 安装与更换
documents.text:
悉尼木 Sleeper 安装与更换
整理花园边界、更换老化的木 sleeper，或分隔泥土与草坪。Mel One 可根据现场讨论材料、走向及固定方式，明确你的户外木作范围。

documents.title: 悉尼木 Sleeper 安装与更换 — 花园边框新装
documents.text:
花园边框新装
选择材料和固定方式前，先确定走向、转角与完成高度，并说明与步道、草坪及围栏如何衔接。

documents.title: 悉尼木 Sleeper 安装与更换 — 老化 sleeper 更换
documents.text:
老化 sleeper 更换
检查整段木材，不只看表面；确认稳固固定点，以及是否包含拆旧、地面准备和清运。

documents.title: 悉尼木 Sleeper 安装与更换 — 分隔边界还是挡土？
documents.text:
分隔边界还是挡土？
说明木材只是分隔边界，还是挡住有高低差的泥土；挡土工作需要单独评估支撑和排水。

documents.title: 悉尼木 Sleeper 安装与更换 — 现场需要先看什么
documents.text:
现场需要先看什么
花园木边框松动、腐烂或让泥土流到步道上，不一定只需换一块上层木板。原有支撑、木材接触地面的位置及水流都会影响更换方案；请先说明木材只是分隔边界，还是需要挡住有高低差的泥土。

documents.title: 悉尼木 Sleeper 安装与更换 — 维修、更换或先查原因
documents.text:
维修、更换或先查原因
新装前先确认边界走向、转角、完成高度及材料进出通道。更换时除了受损 sleeper，还要看相邻木材和固定点是否稳固。涉及挡土功能时，应单独评估受力、支撑与排水，再确定方法及报价。

documents.title: 悉尼木 Sleeper 安装与更换 — 工作范围与边界
documents.text:
工作范围与边界
本服务承接花园木边框及小型户外木作的 timber sleeper 询价。挡土墙与简单花园边界不是同一范围；结构设计、排水和可能需要的审批须另行核对。混凝土 sleeper、地下管线附近开挖及泳池安全围栏改动不默认包含。

documents.title: 悉尼木 Sleeper 安装与更换 — 哪些因素影响报价
documents.text:
哪些因素影响报价
提供大致总长度、露出高度、转角数量及两侧照片。材料、地面准备、支撑、搬运通道、拆旧清运与表面收尾应分别说明，避免把仅做花园边框的报价与完整挡土工程直接比较。

documents.title: 悉尼木 Sleeper 安装与更换 — 哪些照片有帮助
documents.text:
哪些照片有帮助
拍下整段计划走向、现有 sleeper、坡度及附近步道、围栏或排水位置。可提供粗略尺寸，不要为拍照开挖或移动不稳的木材。

documents.title: 悉尼木 Sleeper 安装与更换 — 我们的现场木作：楼梯旁的木边框
documents.text:
我们的现场木作：楼梯旁的木边框
这组现场木作展示户外楼梯旁的低矮木边框，以及相邻开口的新木条围板；照片记录施工时的布局。需要安装 sleeper 时，请提供计划走向、长度与地面高低，让花园边框及可能涉及的挡土工作分别确定范围。

documents.title: 悉尼木 Sleeper 安装与更换 — 确认所在地区
documents.text:
确认所在地区
我们承接悉尼及服务目录中列出的 Central Coast、Illawarra 与 Wollondilly 指定地区的住宅木作询价。请说明所在地区和所需工作；安排上门前先沟通范围、通道、时间及是否涉及出行费用。

documents.title: 悉尼木 Sleeper 安装与更换 — 可以只换一块腐烂的 sleeper 吗？
documents.text:
可以只换一块腐烂的 sleeper 吗？
周围木材与支撑稳固时，可以评估局部更换。若多块发软或地面正在移动，应先检查更大范围，避免只遮住问题。

documents.title: 悉尼木 Sleeper 安装与更换 — 除了更换，也做花园木边框新装吗？
documents.text:
除了更换，也做花园木边框新装吗？
可以。说明花园边界、大致长度及希望的外观；新装或更换都先沟通材料与工作范围，再安排施工。

documents.title: 悉尼木 Sleeper 安装与更换 — 花园木边框和 sleeper 挡土墙一样吗？
documents.text:
花园木边框和 sleeper 挡土墙一样吗？
不一样。边框可能只分隔草坪与花坛；如果需要挡住高低差的泥土，就要看挡土量、支撑与排水，不能直接沿用相同做法。

documents.title: 悉尼木 Sleeper 安装与更换 — 应该选择哪种木材？
documents.text:
应该选择哪种木材？
取决于是否接触土壤、暴露环境、用途及可采购产品。购买前确认材料规格与处理方式是否适用，种植区域尤其需要先说明用途。

documents.title: 悉尼木 Sleeper 安装与更换 — 可以与围栏或 Deck 维修一起报价吗？
documents.text:
可以与围栏或 Deck 维修一起报价吗？
可以。分别列出工作并拍下每个位置，让报价区分花园边框、围栏、Deck 和清运，方便决定先做哪些项目。

documents.title: Timber Window Repairs in Sydney
documents.text:
Timber Window Repairs in Sydney
What we can look at

documents.title: Timber Window Repairs in Sydney
documents.text:
Timber Window Repairs in Sydney
A swollen sash, soft sill or decayed frame can have very different causes. Start with the timber component and the way the window opens, then decide whether a local repair is sensible. A sticking sash is another opening symptom to describe.

documents.title: Timber Window Repairs in Sydney — Soft or damaged sills
documents.text:
Soft or damaged sills
Local timber repair or replacement can be considered when the adjoining frame is sound. The moisture source and the finishing needed should be included in the assessment.

documents.title: Timber Window Repairs in Sydney — Windows that bind
documents.text:
Windows that bind
Check the timber, joints and fittings to distinguish a local adjustment from damage that needs replacement. Glass, aluminium frames and specialist sash mechanisms need a separate scope.

documents.title: Timber Window Repairs in Sydney — Repair and finish together
documents.text:
Repair and finish together
Ask whether preparation, sealing and painting are included, and which faces are accessible. Matching an aged frame exactly may not be possible.

documents.title: Timber Window Repairs in Sydney — What the damage may mean
documents.text:
What the damage may mean
Soft timber at the sill, a window that catches after rain, loose joints and peeling finishes are different clues. Show the whole window as well as the damaged edge so the frame, sill and surrounding wall can be considered together. Do not judge the whole window from one damaged patch alone.

documents.title: Timber Window Repairs in Sydney — Repair, replace or investigate
documents.text:
Repair, replace or investigate
The depth of decay, whether the sash and frame remain sound, water entry and safe access determine the repair. A sound section may accept a local timber replacement; widespread damage or a continuing leak needs a wider assessment before a method is agreed.

documents.title: Timber Window Repairs in Sydney — Scope and boundaries
documents.text:
Scope and boundaries
This page concerns timber frames, sills and related carpentry. Glass replacement, aluminium frames, specialist sash-balance mechanisms and heritage conservation are separate scopes. Painting and leak-source work must be stated in the quote rather than assumed.

documents.title: Timber Window Repairs in Sydney — What shapes a quote
documents.text:
What shapes a quote
Send the window type, opening direction, a wide view, a close view of the sill and the wall junction. Access, matching profiles, timber choice, making good and painting affect the scope and price. One close-up alone cannot establish the price.

documents.title: Timber Window Repairs in Sydney — Useful photos
documents.text:
Useful photos
Photograph the full window, soft sill and frame corners from a safe position; include the floor level and access.

documents.title: Timber Window Repairs in Sydney — Useful photos
documents.text:
Useful photos
Do not put yourself at risk to take a photo.

documents.title: Timber Window Repairs in Sydney — Real case photos: timber-window frames
documents.text:
Real case photos: timber-window frames
These photos show timber-window frames and painted surrounds from real jobs. Repainting timber window frames, local timber repair and glass work are separate decisions: the wood and existing coating need checking, and the agreed finish belongs in the written quote.

documents.title: Timber Window Repairs in Sydney — Check the location
documents.text:
Check the location
We take residential timber enquiries in Sydney and the selected Central Coast, Illawarra and Wollondilly locations listed in our service directory. Tell us your suburb and the work needed; we will discuss scope, access, timing and any travel charges before arranging a visit.

documents.title: Timber Window Repairs in Sydney — Can only a rotten sill be replaced?
documents.text:
Can only a rotten sill be replaced?
Sometimes, if the adjoining frame is sound and the source of moisture is understood. An inspection confirms how far the damage runs.

documents.title: Timber Window Repairs in Sydney — Why does the window stick?
documents.text:
Why does the window stick?
Moisture movement, paint build-up, hardware or frame movement can each cause binding. The remedy depends on the actual cause.

documents.title: Timber Window Repairs in Sydney — Is glass or painting included?
documents.text:
Is glass or painting included?
Neither is automatic. The written scope should separate glass work, timber repair and finishing.

documents.title: 悉尼木窗与木窗框维修
documents.text:
悉尼木窗与木窗框维修
窗台发软、木框腐烂或木窗扇膨胀、卡住，成因不一定相同。先确认受损构件和开合方式，再判断局部维修是否合适。

documents.title: 悉尼木窗与木窗框维修 — 窗台发软或破损
documents.text:
窗台发软或破损
相邻窗框稳固时，可评估局部木材修补或更换，同时确认受潮来源及所需表面收尾。

documents.title: 悉尼木窗与木窗框维修 — 木窗开关卡顿
documents.text:
木窗开关卡顿
检查木材、接合处及五金，区分可调整的问题与需要更换的损坏；玻璃、铝框和专门的提拉窗机构须另外确认。

documents.title: 悉尼木窗与木窗框维修 — 维修后的表面收尾
documents.text:
维修后的表面收尾
确认前处理、封闭及刷漆是否包含，哪些面可施工。老旧窗框的颜色与纹理未必能完全一致。

documents.title: 悉尼木窗与木窗框维修 — 这些损坏可能意味着什么
documents.text:
这些损坏可能意味着什么
窗台木材松软、雨后窗扇卡住、接缝松动与漆膜脱落，代表的可能是不同问题。请同时说明整扇窗和受损边角，让窗框、窗台及相邻墙体的情况能够一起判断，而不是只看一块局部。

documents.title: 悉尼木窗与木窗框维修 — 维修、更换或先查原因
documents.text:
维修、更换或先查原因
腐烂深度、窗扇和主框是否仍稳固、进水来源以及安全通道，都会改变维修方法。周边木材完好时可评估局部更换；若损坏蔓延或持续漏水，需要先厘清整体范围。

documents.title: 悉尼木窗与木窗框维修 — 工作范围与边界
documents.text:
工作范围与边界
本页讨论木窗框、木窗台及相关木工构件。玻璃更换、铝合金窗、专门的上下推拉窗平衡机构和历史建筑修复不默认包含；油漆收尾及漏水源处理须在报价中单独写明。

documents.title: 悉尼木窗与木窗框维修 — 哪些因素影响报价
documents.text:
哪些因素影响报价
请提供窗型、开启方向、全景、窗台近照及与墙面交接处。进出通道、木材与线条匹配、修补和油漆范围都会影响报价，不能只凭一个近照确定价格。

documents.title: 悉尼木窗与木窗框维修 — 哪些照片有帮助
documents.text:
哪些照片有帮助
从安全位置拍整窗、发软的窗台与木框角落，并说明楼层和可进入位置。

documents.title: 悉尼木窗与木窗框维修 — 真实案例照片：木窗框
documents.text:
真实案例照片：木窗框
这些真实案例照片展示木窗框和已刷漆的周边。窗框刷漆翻新、局部木材维修与玻璃工作应分别界定；先看木材及旧漆状况，再把同意的表面处理写进报价。

documents.title: 悉尼木窗与木窗框维修 — 确认所在地区
documents.text:
确认所在地区
我们承接悉尼及服务目录中列出的 Central Coast、Illawarra 与 Wollondilly 指定地区的住宅木作询价。请说明所在地区和所需工作；安排上门前先沟通范围、通道、时间及是否涉及出行费用。

documents.title: 悉尼木窗与木窗框维修 — 能否只换腐烂的木窗台？
documents.text:
能否只换腐烂的木窗台？
如相邻框架完好、受潮原因已厘清，可评估局部更换；实际范围需查看后确定。

documents.title: 悉尼木窗与木窗框维修 — 木窗为什么卡住？
documents.text:
木窗为什么卡住？
受潮膨胀、油漆堆积、五金或框架移动都可能造成卡滞，处理方式取决于成因。

documents.title: 悉尼木窗与木窗框维修 — 玻璃和油漆是否包含？
documents.text:
玻璃和油漆是否包含？
都不应默认包含；报价应将玻璃、木作和收尾分别写清。

documents.title: Under-House Timber Screening & Battens in Sydney
documents.text:
Under-House Timber Screening & Battens in Sydney
What we can look at

documents.title: Under-House Timber Screening & Battens in Sydney
documents.text:
Under-House Timber Screening & Battens in Sydney
Replace damaged timber battens or add a neatly spaced screen below a raised house, deck or outdoor stair. Plan the layout around the access and ventilation the space still needs.

documents.title: Under-House Timber Screening & Battens in Sydney — Replace damaged battens
documents.text:
Replace damaged battens
Assess the fixing timber behind the screen, then discuss replacing individual boards or a wider section while retaining sound parts.

documents.title: Under-House Timber Screening & Battens in Sydney — Screen an open area
documents.text:
Screen an open area
Agree batten spacing, corner details and the line beside steps. Keep necessary ventilation, inspection and service access in the layout.

documents.title: Under-House Timber Screening & Battens in Sydney — Plan the finish
documents.text:
Plan the finish
Specify whether timber is left uncoated or prepared for an agreed paint or stain. Include removable sections and disposal in the scope where required.

documents.title: Under-House Timber Screening & Battens in Sydney — What needs attention at the site
documents.text:
What needs attention at the site
Missing boards, soft lower ends and loose fixings can leave an untidy opening below the house or deck. A new screen needs a sound fixing surface; covering deteriorated posts or framing does not repair them. Show the whole opening and the timber behind the existing boards.

documents.title: Under-House Timber Screening & Battens in Sydney — Repair, replace or investigate
documents.text:
Repair, replace or investigate
Discuss vertical or horizontal battens, spacing, corner returns and the line along steps or sloping ground. Check where timber can be fixed and which parts need to remain accessible. Local board replacement and screening a whole opening are different jobs and can be quoted separately.

documents.title: Under-House Timber Screening & Battens in Sydney — Scope and boundaries
documents.text:
Scope and boundaries
The screen is a non-structural timber finish, not a replacement for the house supports, a waterproof enclosure or a certified pool barrier. Ventilation, inspection access, drainage and access to services must be considered. Any structural damage or pool-safety implications require a separate assessment before work is agreed.

documents.title: Under-House Timber Screening & Battens in Sydney — What shapes a quote
documents.text:
What shapes a quote
The number and size of openings, batten dimensions, spacing, support preparation, removable access sections and coating change the quote. Confirm whether removal of old boards, painting or staining, and waste removal are included. New timber may look different from weathered boards beside it.

documents.title: Under-House Timber Screening & Battens in Sydney — Useful photos
documents.text:
Useful photos
Send a front view and an angle showing the depth of the opening, steps, ground line and visible fixing surfaces. Point out access hatches or services that must stay reachable; do not crawl into an unsafe space.

documents.title: Under-House Timber Screening & Battens in Sydney — Useful photos
documents.text:
Useful photos
Do not put yourself at risk to take a photo.

documents.title: Under-House Timber Screening & Battens in Sydney — Real work: new battens below the house and stairs
documents.text:
Real work: new battens below the house and stairs
The photos follow the same outdoor area from timber preparation to views of the newly fitted battens. They show unpainted boards, corner details and the ground line—not a finished painted surface. Spacing, access and the finish are decisions to agree for your own project.

documents.title: Under-House Timber Screening & Battens in Sydney — Check the location
documents.text:
Check the location
We take residential timber enquiries in Sydney and the selected Central Coast, Illawarra and Wollondilly locations listed in our service directory. Tell us your suburb and the work needed; we will discuss scope, access, timing and any travel charges before arranging a visit.

documents.title: Under-House Timber Screening & Battens in Sydney — Can the old battens be replaced without rebuilding the deck?
documents.text:
Can the old battens be replaced without rebuilding the deck?
Potentially, if the battens are a separate non-structural screen and their supporting timber is sound. The deck structure needs separate checking if it is loose, soft or damaged. A new screen should not simply conceal a damaged deck structure.

documents.title: Under-House Timber Screening & Battens in Sydney — Can I keep access beneath the house?
documents.text:
Can I keep access beneath the house?
Yes—discuss the access position and whether a removable section is needed before setting out the screen. Do not cover service access or inspection points without a suitable arrangement.

documents.title: Under-House Timber Screening & Battens in Sydney — Is painting included?
documents.text:
Is painting included?
Only when included in the agreed scope. Confirm preparation, the coating, accessible faces and colour; unpainted replacement battens are not the same as a completed painted finish.

documents.title: Under-House Timber Screening & Battens in Sydney — Can this be combined with timber sleeper edging?
documents.text:
Can this be combined with timber sleeper edging?
Yes. Screening the opening and defining the soil or lawn edge can be considered together, while keeping support, drainage and ground clearance decisions separate.

documents.title: 悉尼屋下木条围板与遮挡木作
documents.text:
悉尼屋下木条围板与遮挡木作
更换破损木条，或为架空房屋、Deck 与户外楼梯下方安装整齐的木条围板。设计排列时，同时保留需要的通风与检修通道。

documents.title: 悉尼屋下木条围板与遮挡木作 — 更换破损木条
documents.text:
更换破损木条
先检查围板背后的固定木材，再讨论换个别木条或较大范围，同时保留稳固部分。

documents.title: 悉尼屋下木条围板与遮挡木作 — 为开口安装围板
documents.text:
为开口安装围板
明确木条间距、转角与楼梯旁收边，并在布局中保留必要的通风、检查及设备检修通道。

documents.title: 悉尼屋下木条围板与遮挡木作 — 确认表面收尾
documents.text:
确认表面收尾
明确保留未涂装木材，还是进行同意的刷漆或木色涂层处理；需要的可拆段与清运也应列入范围。

documents.title: 悉尼屋下木条围板与遮挡木作 — 现场需要先看什么
documents.text:
现场需要先看什么
木条缺失、底端发软及固定件松动，会让屋下或 Deck 下方出现不整齐的开口。新围板需要稳固的固定位置；把腐烂立柱或骨架遮住，不等于修好了支撑。请拍下整个开口及旧围板背后的可见木材。

documents.title: 悉尼屋下木条围板与遮挡木作 — 维修、更换或先查原因
documents.text:
维修、更换或先查原因
先讨论竖向或横向木条、间距、转角及沿楼梯和地面的收边。确认哪些位置能固定、哪些位置必须保留进入通道。只换几块板与整段开口重新做围板不同，可分别列入报价比较。

documents.title: 悉尼屋下木条围板与遮挡木作 — 工作范围与边界
documents.text:
工作范围与边界
这里的围板属于非承重木作收尾，不代替房屋支撑、防水封闭空间或经过认证的泳池安全围栏。通风、检查通道、排水及设备检修需要一起考虑；发现结构损坏或涉及泳池安全时，须先另外评估再确认工作。

documents.title: 悉尼屋下木条围板与遮挡木作 — 哪些因素影响报价
documents.text:
哪些因素影响报价
开口数量与尺寸、木条规格和间距、固定基层准备、可拆检修段及涂层都会改变报价。应确认是否包含拆旧、刷漆或着色及清运；新木条的色泽不一定与旁边风化木材一致。

documents.title: 悉尼屋下木条围板与遮挡木作 — 哪些照片有帮助
documents.text:
哪些照片有帮助
提供正面和斜侧全景，显示开口深度、楼梯、地面走向及可见固定位置。指出检修口和必须保留通道的设备，不要进入不安全的屋下空间。

documents.title: 悉尼屋下木条围板与遮挡木作 — 真实木作：房屋与楼梯下方的新木条围板
documents.text:
真实木作：房屋与楼梯下方的新木条围板
照片记录同一户外区域的木料准备和新木条安装情况，可看见未刷漆木条、转角与地面衔接，展示的不是刷漆完成面。你的项目可先讨论木条间距、检修通道及希望的表面收尾。

documents.title: 悉尼屋下木条围板与遮挡木作 — 确认所在地区
documents.text:
确认所在地区
我们承接悉尼及服务目录中列出的 Central Coast、Illawarra 与 Wollondilly 指定地区的住宅木作询价。请说明所在地区和所需工作；安排上门前先沟通范围、通道、时间及是否涉及出行费用。

documents.title: 悉尼屋下木条围板与遮挡木作 — 可以只换围板，不重做整个 Deck 吗？
documents.text:
可以只换围板，不重做整个 Deck 吗？
如果围板属于独立非承重部分且固定木材稳固，可以评估。Deck 结构如有松动、发软或破损，则要另行检查，不能只用新围板遮住。

documents.title: 悉尼屋下木条围板与遮挡木作 — 还能保留进入屋下的通道吗？
documents.text:
还能保留进入屋下的通道吗？
可以，排板前先确定进入位置及是否需要可拆段。设备检修与检查位置必须有合适安排，不应直接封住。

documents.title: 悉尼屋下木条围板与遮挡木作 — 包含刷漆吗？
documents.text:
包含刷漆吗？
以约定范围为准，需明确前处理、涂层、可施工面及颜色。装上未刷漆新木条与完成整段刷漆，是不同的交付范围。

documents.title: 悉尼屋下木条围板与遮挡木作 — 可以和木 sleeper 边框一起做吗？
documents.text:
可以和木 sleeper 边框一起做吗？
可以一起讨论屋下遮挡与泥土、草坪边界，但支撑、排水及木材与地面的间隙仍需分别考虑。
